messages.词条数量怎么算？查看公式与 S 级数值表: How are rolls counted? Formula and S-Rank values
messages.总份数 = 该项副属性数值 ÷ 单份数值。首次出现算 1 份，之后每追加一次再加: Total rolls = substat value ÷ value per roll. The initial occurrence counts as 1, then each upgrade adds 1. For example, 19.2% CRIT DMG ÷ 4.8% = 4 rolls, shown as +3 beside the in-game stat. That +3 is separate from a disc’s level +3.
messages.S 级盘每到 3、6、9、12、15 级有一次成长节点。初始三条盘在 3 级补出: S-Rank discs gain a substat event at levels 3, 6, 9, 12, and 15. A disc starting with 3 substats unlocks its fourth at level 3, leaving 4 upgrades. A 4-substat disc gets 5 upgrades. Max-level totals are therefore 3 + 5 = 8 or 4 + 5 = 9 rolls, across at most 4 different substats. Main stats are excluded.
messages.“有效词条”要结合角色、玩法、技能、影画、音擎与配队判断，还要考虑属性上限和转换: Useful rolls depend on the Agent, playstyle, skills, Mindscapes, W-Engine, team, stat caps, and conversions. Priority substats below reflect the selected guide. Rolls do not all have equal value, and this count is not the in-game combat-readiness assessment.
messages.换盘规划先算当前六盘，再比较适用的面板目标，把缺口分配到可调整号位。它不会把总份: The planner calculates your six current discs, compares applicable stat targets, then distributes the shortfall across adjustable slots. Total rolls are not a completion score, and discs need not have identical roll counts. Incomplete discs only contribute entered stats. “At least” in a replacement target is a minimum; remaining substats are unspecified.

messages.这是当前方案的条件备选；先核对角色的循环与增益门槛，再比较副词条。: This is a conditional alternative for the current build. Check rotation and buff thresholds before comparing substats.
messages.主属性与当前角色参考不同；先确认流派及功能需求，再考虑副词条培养。: The main stat differs from the Agent reference. Confirm your playstyle and functional needs before investing in substats.

messages.按所提供的 2025 年攻略整理选择思路，再使用本页当前角色建议或自选属性；不是: Uses the supplied 2025 guide’s selection approach with this page’s Agent recommendations or your chosen stats. This is not an official HoYoLAB rating.
messages.检查顺序为套装方向、主属性、副属性。单盘命中套装候选，不代表整套 4+2 已配齐: Checks set choice, main stat, then substats. Matching a set candidate on one disc does not confirm a complete 4+2 build or active conditional buffs.
messages.“两种、三种”统计不同的核心副属性，不是强化份数；同一种属性追加多次仍只算一种。: “Two or three types” counts distinct priority substats, not upgrade rolls. Repeated upgrades to one stat still count as one type.
messages.未强化盘具备两种所需副属性可列为培养候选；强攻、命破可优先看三种，但两种并不等于: An unleveled disc with two desired substats can be an upgrade candidate. Attack and Rupture builds may prioritize three, but two does not make a disc bad.
messages.强化后的盘只判断当前种类与匹配情况，不能还原初始属性；功能型角色先看自身门槛。: Leveled discs are assessed on current stat types and fit; starting stats cannot be reconstructed. Utility Agents prioritize their own thresholds.
messages.攻略定位表包含主属性：冲击力、异常掌控、能量自动回复、穿透率应检查主属性或其他装: The guide’s role table includes main stats: Impact, Anomaly Mastery, Energy Regen, and PEN Ratio should be checked through main stats or other equipment, not counted as substat types.
messages.有效份数沿用已验证的词条记录，核心与补充分别统计。攻略未给出字母等级或通用最优公: Useful rolls use verified stat records, with priority and supplementary rolls counted separately. The guide does not provide letter grades or a universal optimization formula.
messages.5 号盘要结合角色、音擎、队友与敌人比较；不能仅凭面板，把属性增伤、攻击/生命或: Compare slot 5 with the Agent, W-Engine, teammates, and enemy in mind. Attribute DMG, ATK/HP, and PEN Ratio do not have a fixed universal ranking based on displayed stats alone.
messages.穿透辅助会改变穿透率收益；减防、无视防御与战斗增伤也会影响比较。这里没有完整战斗: PEN support changes PEN Ratio’s value, while DEF reduction, DEF ignore, and combat DMG buffs also affect comparisons. Without complete combat conditions, the guide’s simplified thresholds are not used to automatically choose a winner.
messages.命破的贯穿伤害不吃敌人防御，穿透率与穿透值不作为贯穿输出的有效属性；具体生命/攻: Rupture Agents’ Sheer DMG bypasses enemy DEF, so PEN Ratio and flat PEN are not useful for Sheer DMG. HP/ATK scaling still follows the specific Agent’s skills.
messages.5 号穿透率即使不在当前参考清单，也先标为需结合队伍；合法属性不直接判为错误。: Even when slot 5 PEN Ratio is outside the reference list, it is marked for team review rather than treated as an invalid choice.
messages.按本页自选属性统计，补充属性单列，不代表等价伤害。: Counts your selected stats, with supplementary stats listed separately. Rolls do not represent equivalent damage.
messages.已录入属性参与整套计算，本方案保留此盘。: Entered stats count toward the full build. This plan keeps the disc.
messages.个人配装保留自身技能、影画、音擎及辅助门槛。这里没有模拟只带一名角色出战，也没有: Individual builds retain the Agent’s own skills, Mindscapes, W-Engine, and support thresholds. This does not simulate solo combat or automatically add effects requiring teammates or combat triggers. Those conditions are explained below.
messages.技能、影画、专武、套装与队友条件分开核对。下列触发句并不表示增益已经加入上方装备: Skills, Mindscapes, signature W-Engine, sets, and teammate conditions are checked separately. Activation text below does not mean the buff is included in the equipment stats above. Unconfirmed conditions are not treated as active.
messages.核心技能与额外能力：按触发条件核对: Core Skill & Additional Ability: check activation conditions
messages.此数字是特定效果的增益，不是需要刷到的面板目标。: This number is the bonus from a specific effect, not a stat target you need to farm.
messages.此处保留技能机制条件；不自动当作整名角色的毕业线。: These skill conditions are retained as written, not automatically treated as a finished-build threshold for the whole Agent.

messages.攻略目标按角色60级、核心F整理；先调整规划等级或只查看逐号位建议。: Guide targets assume Agent Lv. 60 and Core Skill F. Adjust the planned levels or view slot guidance only.
messages.该角色存在尚未对齐的面板转换。可查看机制或明确选择按参考口径试算，不能直接判定毕: This Agent has stat conversions not yet aligned with the reference. Review the mechanics or explicitly estimate using guide assumptions; the result cannot directly certify a finished build.
messages.当前配队未满足目标的适用条件，不能通过勾选参考口径绕过；请核对队友与目标前提。: The team does not meet the target’s conditions. Enabling reference assumptions cannot bypass them; check teammates and requirements.
messages.当前没有可直接比较的目标。可选择按攻略参考口径试算，或查看可用档的套装与主属性建: No directly comparable target is available. Estimate using the guide’s assumptions, or view Usable-tier set and main stat suggestions.
messages.保留的盘为空或属性资料未确认，请先核对该盘；不会自动替换锁定盘。: A kept disc is empty or has unverified stats. Check it first; locked discs are not replaced automatically.
messages.高于攻略所用配置的上限参考，需核对已包含的暴击增益，不判为完成: Above the cap reference for the guide’s configuration. Check included CRIT buffs; completion is not confirmed.
messages.按换盘号位子集递增，贪心分配后尝试跨盘迁移；子集枚举完成不代表穷尽全部副属性状态: Searches increasing subsets of replacement slots, then greedily allocates rolls and tries transfers between discs. Enumerating slot subsets does not exhaust every substat state.
messages.从空白目标重新分配未保留盘；遵守单盘约束，未声称全局最少材料或最大伤害。: Reallocates unlocked discs from blank targets while respecting per-disc constraints. No global minimum-material or maximum-damage claim is made.
messages.已录入属性已满足下限目标，保持原盘；部分副属性未录入，上限仍待核对。: Entered stats meet the lower-bound targets, so the original discs are kept. Some substats are missing; caps still need checking.
messages.现有六盘已覆盖本次可比较的数值目标，保持原等级和录入属性；未填全的副属性不作补全: The six current discs cover the comparable numerical targets. Original levels and entered stats are retained; missing substats are not guessed or filled in.
messages.从现有六盘出发，先尝试较少换盘；保留锁定盘，有限搜索并尝试迁移属性份数。结果是已: Starts from the six current discs and tries fewer replacements first. Locked discs are kept while a bounded search tries roll transfers. The result is a candidate found so far, not a guarantee of globally lowest costs or highest damage.
messages.主属性候选与保留盘冲突，未更改保留盘。: The main stat candidate conflicts with a kept disc. The kept disc was not changed.
messages.搜索额度已用完，尚未找到可评估候选；不能据此认定无解。: The search budget was exhausted without an evaluable candidate. This does not prove there is no solution.
messages.尚未找到可评估候选，请核对盘的资料与保留条件。: No evaluable candidate found yet. Check disc data and keep constraints.

messages.这是逐张目标盘的资源比较，不保证整套最少材料或最大面板提升。: This compares resources for individual target discs. It does not guarantee minimum total materials or maximum stat gains for the full build.
messages.4000 初始攻击是三异常队伍且额外能力生效时，40%分享达到1600上限的特定: 4,000 initial ATK is a team-specific reference: with three Anomaly Agents and Additional Ability active, 40% sharing reaches the 1,600 cap. Individual-build mode does not assume this team, so the target is listed separately.
messages.4000 攻击参考的三异常前提: Three-Anomaly requirement for the 4,000 ATK reference
messages.当前为三名不同异常代理人，4000 初始攻击对应额外能力 40% 分享的 160: The team has three different Anomaly Agents. At 4,000 initial ATK, Additional Ability’s 40% share reaches the 1,600 cap. This is not a universal endgame ATK target.
messages.4000 初始攻击的分享上限参考仅适用于三异常且额外能力生效；当前前提未确认，不: The 4,000 initial ATK sharing-cap reference only applies with three Anomaly Agents and an active Additional Ability. These requirements are unconfirmed, so the ATK target is not marked complete.
messages.丽娜队穿透方案的队友前提: Rina team requirement for the PEN build
messages.个人配装暂不指定队友；该穿透备选仍需核对丽娜队条件，本次不计丽娜分享。: Individual mode does not specify teammates. This PEN alternative still requires checking the Rina team condition; Rina’s share is not included.
messages.已选择丽娜；穿透分享的实际覆盖、其他减防及收益仍未量化，不能据此判为普适最优。: Rina is selected. PEN-sharing uptime, other DEF reduction, and gains remain unquantified, so this is not established as universally optimal.
messages.该备选方案以丽娜队为条件；当前未确认丽娜入队，穿透方案收益待核实。: This alternative assumes Rina. Her presence is not confirmed, so the PEN build’s value needs checking.
messages.山大王四件：装备者职业: King of the Summit 4-piece: equipper specialty
messages.四件增益要求装备者为击破；额外暴伤还需至少 50% 暴击并实际发动强化特殊技或连: The 4-piece bonus requires a Stun equipper. Extra CRIT DMG also requires at least 50% CRIT Rate and an actual EX Special Attack or Chain Attack. Activation is not assumed here.
messages.四件全队增伤要求装备者为防护，实际触发和层数需另行确认。: The 4-piece team DMG bonus requires a Defense equipper. Actual activation and stacks need separate confirmation.
messages.第三方 Gachabase 3.3.2 测试服，修订 18895034；不替换: Third-party Gachabase Version 3.3.2 beta, revision 18895034; this does not replace the released Version 3.2 data.
messages.角色Lv.60/60，核心F，页面属性栏读数；无音擎、驱动盘及战斗加成，不是毕业: Agent Lv. 60/60, Core Skill F: values from the source's stat panel, without a W-Engine, Drive Discs, or combat bonuses. These are not endgame build targets.
messages.余火上限120；长按普攻消耗90，并对异常目标结算异放。: Embers cap at 120. Holding Basic Attack consumes 90 and triggers Abloom against an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly.
messages.技能12级：长按普攻异放464%；终结技异放623%。仅指异放倍率。: At skill Lv. 12: held Basic Attack has a 464% Abloom multiplier; Ultimate has 623%. These figures refer only to Abloom multipliers.
messages.特定重击获取蓄能；后续重击追加火伤。: Specific heavy hits grant Energize; later heavy hits deal additional Fire DMG.
messages.终结技进入消亡；切入可恢复生命。死亡后的重生冷却另为300秒。: The Ultimate enters a death-like state; switching in can restore HP. Resurrection after being defeated has a separate 300-second cooldown.
messages.使队伍异常伤害可暴击。额外能力需另一名异常或同阵营队友，异常人数影响异常暴伤。: Allows the squad's Attribute Anomaly damage to CRIT. The Additional Ability requires another Anomaly Agent or a squad member from the same Faction; the number of Anomaly Agents affects Anomaly CRIT DMG.
messages.核心F；队伍异常暴击与角色面板双暴不同。: Core Skill F. The squad's Anomaly CRIT stats are separate from the Agent's displayed CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG.
messages.入场给蓄能（勘域限时）；异常暴击暴伤+20%，余火获取+15%。: Grants Energize on entering combat, with a time limit in Investigation Zone mode. Anomaly CRIT DMG +20%; Ember gain +15%.
messages.强化特殊技开启焚化；积蓄+15%，二段返8能量。: EX Special Attack activates Incineration: Anomaly Buildup +15%, and the second part restores 8 Energy.
messages.五类战斗技能等级+2。: Adds 2 levels to all five combat skill categories.
messages.队伍异常人数需求减1；新增异放，自身异放无视15%防御。: Reduces the required number of Anomaly squad members by 1, adds another Abloom trigger, and makes the Agent's own Abloom ignore 15% DEF.
messages.音擎Lv.60/60；高级属性百分比加成: W-Engine Lv. 60/60; percentage bonus from its advanced stat
messages.1阶提升75点异常精通；任意队员的异常伤害产生暴击后，装备者火伤+40%，持续2: At 1 star: Anomaly Proficiency +75. When any squad member's Anomaly damage scores a CRIT, the equipper gains 40% Fire DMG for 20 seconds; triggering it again refreshes the duration.
messages.本次仅核到同修订号的1阶效果，暂不列出2～5阶成长。: Only the 1-star effect was verified for the same revision. Scaling for stars 2–5 is not listed yet.
messages.页面栏已计核心解锁的攻击+75、掌控+36；被动精通+40另列。: The source's stat panel already includes +75 ATK and +36 Anomaly Mastery from Core Skill unlocks. The passive +40 Anomaly Proficiency is listed separately.
messages.核心F：异常暴击基础30%/15%；掌控145门槛措辞有歧义，不据此推算满暴需求: At Core Skill F, base Anomaly CRIT Rate/DMG is 30%/15%. The wording of the 145 Anomaly Mastery threshold is ambiguous, so it is not used to infer the requirement for 100% CRIT Rate.
messages.源站配置推荐：4号异常精通，5号火伤，6号异常掌控；均备选攻击%。副词条优先异常: The source recommends Anomaly Proficiency in slot 4, Fire DMG in slot 5, and Anomaly Mastery in slot 6, with ATK% as an alternative for each. Prioritize Anomaly Proficiency and ATK substats.
messages.尚无经过实战核验的毕业区间。: No endgame target ranges have been verified in actual combat yet.
messages.Lv.60/60、核心 F；GachaBase 页面基础栏，未装音擎/驱动盘。: Lv. 60/60, Core Skill F: the base stat panel on GachaBase, without a W-Engine or Drive Discs.
messages.资源上限150；普攻第四段回20，强化连斩消耗100。: The resource caps at 150. The fourth Basic Attack hit restores 20; the enhanced slash sequence consumes 100.
messages.极限闪避回资源；入场及强化特殊技可获得自动闪避层数。: Perfect Dodges restore the resource. Entering combat and using EX Special Attack can grant stacks for automatic dodges.
messages.消耗闪避层数强化末段；队伍需支援、击破或同阵营角色，入战/切入可获条件攻击加成。: Consumes dodge stacks to enhance the final hit. Requires a Support, Stun, or same-Faction squad member; entering combat or switching in can grant a conditional ATK bonus.
messages.核心F；额外攻击随等级提升、最高700，持续30秒。: Core Skill F. Bonus ATK scales with level, up to 700, and lasts 30 seconds.
messages.入场给100资源（勘域限时）；普攻暴伤+60%。: Grants 100 resource on entering combat, with a time limit in Investigation Zone mode; Basic Attack CRIT DMG +60%.
messages.入场技变连携；强化连斩给层数，额外能力加15%攻击。: The entry attack becomes a Chain Attack; the enhanced slash sequence grants stacks, and the Additional Ability grants an extra 15% ATK.
messages.极限闪避或强化连斩后，无视16%防御15秒。: After a Perfect Dodge or enhanced slash sequence, ignores 16% DEF for 15 seconds.
messages.资源上限180；强化连斩末段加倍率，并短暂持续回资源。: Raises the resource cap to 180, increases the final-hit multiplier of the enhanced slash sequence, and briefly restores resource over time.
messages.Lv.60/60，页面所列。: Lv. 60/60, as listed on the source page.
messages.暴伤+24%；普攻命中后攻击+15%，无视20%风抗，持续20秒。: CRIT DMG +24%. After a Basic Attack hits, ATK +15% and ignores 20% Wind RES for 20 seconds.
messages.暴伤+27.6%；普攻命中后攻击+17.3%，无视23%风抗，持续20秒。: CRIT DMG +27.6%. After a Basic Attack hits, ATK +17.3% and ignores 23% Wind RES for 20 seconds.
messages.暴伤+31.2%；普攻命中后攻击+19.5%，无视26%风抗，持续20秒。: CRIT DMG +31.2%. After a Basic Attack hits, ATK +19.5% and ignores 26% Wind RES for 20 seconds.
messages.暴伤+34.8%；普攻命中后攻击+21.8%，无视29%风抗，持续20秒。: CRIT DMG +34.8%. After a Basic Attack hits, ATK +21.8% and ignores 29% Wind RES for 20 seconds.
messages.暴伤+38.4%；普攻命中后攻击+24%，无视32%风抗，持续20秒。: CRIT DMG +38.4%. After a Basic Attack hits, ATK +24% and ignores 32% Wind RES for 20 seconds.
messages.页面栏已计核心解锁的攻击+75、暴击率+14.4%；核心被动暴伤+60%及条件攻: The source's stat panel already includes +75 ATK and +14.4% CRIT Rate from Core Skill unlocks. The Core Passive's +60% CRIT DMG and conditional ATK are listed separately.
messages.核心正文与弹窗的两层强化倍率冲突，暂不采用争议倍率。: The Core Passive's main text and tooltip disagree on the multiplier with two enhancement stacks; the disputed multiplier is not used for now.
messages.源站暂未提供该角色的培养推荐；不据测试机制生成毕业区间。: The source does not yet provide build recommendations for this Agent. Endgame target ranges are not generated from beta mechanics alone.
messages.官方已公开的角色预告；上线版本与时间以调频公告为准。: Officially revealed Agent previews; release versions and dates follow Signal Search announcements.
messages.坎卜斯黑枝的裁决官。她出门前会备好葡萄糖、设置急救快捷键，并向照共享定位；就连去: A Judge of the Krampus Compliance Authority. Before going out, she prepares glucose, sets an emergency shortcut, and shares her location with Zhao—even a trip to the supermarket calls for careful preparation.

messages.核心强化雷电相关招式的失衡值；先保证6号冲击力与实战击破循环。: The Core increases Daze from the specified Electric moves. Prioritize slot 6 Impact and a reliable Stun rotation.
messages.副词条输出好不代表击破更快；先检查冲击主属性、套装覆盖与技能等级。: Good damage substats do not necessarily mean faster Stuns. Check the Impact main stat, set uptime, and skill levels first.
messages.这是依据技能与套装触发条件整理的搭配参考，未验证不同影画、音擎、队伍和敌人下的最: This build reference follows skill and set activation conditions. Optimal damage has not been verified for every Mindscape, W-Engine, team, and enemy.
messages.冲击力与普通攻击、冲刺攻击、闪避反击的失衡值增益适合前场击破。: Impact and the Daze bonuses for Basic Attack, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter support on-field Stun.
messages.四件增益只覆盖注明招式和主要目标，不能当成所有技能失衡值加成。: The 4-piece bonus only covers the specified moves and primary target. It is not a Daze bonus for every skill.
messages.闪避反击或快速支援命中可触发自身增伤，队伍强击还能强化后续攻击。: Hits from Dodge Counter or Quick Assist activate a personal damage bonus. Assault triggered by the team can strengthen subsequent attacks.
messages.暴击率与暴击伤害按已有音擎、队友及战斗内增益调整，已覆盖的暴击率不要继续堆到溢出: Adjust CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG for your W-Engine, teammates, and combat buffs. Do not keep adding CRIT Rate after those sources cover the target.
messages.队伍触发强击后提供对目标的伤害增益，配合物理输出。: The team’s Assault triggers increase damage against the target, supporting Physical damage.
messages.需要队伍实际施加强击；强击触发前或换目标后不能默认增益已生效。: The team must actually inflict Assault. Do not assume the bonus is active before Assault or after changing targets.
messages.核心减防幅度由技能等级决定，不随妮可攻击力、暴击或异常精通提高。优先让能量场及时: The Core’s DEF reduction depends on skill level, not Nicole’s ATK, CRIT, or Anomaly Proficiency. Prioritize energy-field coverage during teammates’ damage windows.
messages.能量自动回复与支援角色触发的全队增伤有助于维持辅助循环。: Energy Regen and the team damage bonus triggered by a Support Agent help sustain the support rotation.
messages.四件只由支援角色的强化特殊技或终结技触发，持续25秒，同名增益不叠加。: Only a Support Agent’s EX Special Attack or Ultimate triggers the 4-piece effect. It lasts 25 seconds, and effects with the same name do not stack.
messages.核心直接强化火力镇压的普攻、冲刺攻击，可优先检查普攻伤害覆盖。: The Core directly boosts Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks during Fire Suppression. Check Basic Attack damage coverage first.
messages.持续强化普通攻击伤害，适合技能明确依赖普攻的强攻代理人。: A sustained Basic Attack bonus suits Attack Agents whose skills explicitly rely on Basic Attacks.
messages.四件第二段普攻增益仅强攻角色可由强化特殊技或终结技触发；不增益所有招式。: Only an Attack Agent’s EX Special Attack or Ultimate can trigger the 4-piece effect’s second Basic Attack bonus. It does not boost every move.
messages.核心明确每1点最大生命值额外提供0.1点贯穿力，主要属性伤害使用贯穿力；以生命和: The Core explicitly grants 0.1 additional Sheer Force per point of Max HP. The main Attribute damage scales with Sheer Force, so HP and CRIT are the reference priorities.
messages.贯穿伤害无视敌人防御，穿透率不能据此视作有效增伤；贯穿力本身不是可选驱动盘主属性: Sheer DMG ignores enemy DEF, so PEN Ratio is not an effective bonus for that damage. Sheer Force itself is not an available Drive Disc main stat.
messages.生命两件配合生命转贯穿力；叠满四件后提高贯穿伤害。: The HP 2-piece effect supports HP-to-Sheer-Force conversion. Full 4-piece stacks increase Sheer DMG.
messages.强化特殊技、连携技或终结技触发暴击率层数；贯穿增伤需要保持3层。: EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate generates CRIT Rate stacks. The Sheer DMG bonus requires maintaining 3 stacks.
messages.核心强化电锯持续斩击，对失衡敌人另有增伤；以爆发期间的攻击和双暴为参考。: The Core strengthens sustained chainsaw attacks and adds damage against Stunned enemies. Use ATK and CRIT during the burst window as the reference.
messages.荣光之盾按初始冲击力计算，不按防御力或生命值计算；冲击力也服务于击破。: The shield scales with initial Impact, not DEF or HP. Impact also supports the Agent’s Stun role.
messages.防护角色通过强化特殊技或队伍招架、回避支援叠加全队增伤。: A Defense Agent builds team damage stacks through EX Special Attack or the squad’s Defensive/Evasive Assists.
messages.四件要求防护角色装备，最多3层且逐层衰减；同名增益不叠加。: A Defense Agent must equip the 4-piece set. It has up to 3 stacks that decay one at a time, and effects with the same name do not stack.
messages.蹲姿射击提供自身增伤，普攻是可明确验证的套装覆盖对象。: Crouching shots provide a personal damage bonus. Basic Attack is an explicitly supported target for the set effect.
messages.冰焰的烈霜积蓄效率随自身暴击率提高，核心满级时最多提高80%；不能按一般异常角色: Frost buildup from the Core effect scales with CRIT Rate, up to 80% at maximum Core level. Do not replace CRIT with Anomaly Proficiency as if this were a conventional Anomaly build.
messages.6号异常掌控与攻击的取舍需结合积蓄速度和队伍循环，未进行逐队伤害模拟。: Choose Anomaly Mastery or ATK in slot 6 based on buildup speed and team rotation. Individual teams have not been damage-simulated.
messages.暴击伤害与冻结、碎冰后的暴击率契合雅的暴击型烈霜输出。: CRIT DMG and post-Freeze/Shatter CRIT Rate suit Miyabi’s CRIT-based Frost damage.
messages.额外暴击伤害需要异常掌控至少115；暴击率增益需要冻结或碎冰并检查持续时间。: The extra CRIT DMG requires at least 115 Anomaly Mastery. The CRIT Rate buff requires Freeze or Shatter and has limited uptime.
messages.核心提高强化普攻相关招式的失衡值，盘位先满足冲击力，能量套用于检查强化特殊技循环: The Core increases Daze from enhanced Basic Attack-related moves. Prioritize Impact in the disc setup; use Energy sets to assess the EX Special Attack rotation.
messages.3.2已收录潜能觉醒条件分支；本配装参考保留未觉醒基础技能依据。觉醒后的追加能力: The 3.2 Potential Awakening branches are available, but this build reference uses the unawakened skills. Check awakened abilities, moves, and requirements in the skill tab; do not treat awakening effects as base effects.
messages.爆发状态下需要多次暴击才能追加结算感电伤害，兼顾暴击率与感电覆盖。: Multiple critical hits during Burst state are needed for additional Shock damage. Balance CRIT Rate with Shock uptime.
messages.电伤两件与感电存在期间的攻击力加成契合电伤输出。: The Electric DMG 2-piece effect and ATK while Shock is present suit Electric damage.
messages.场上必须保持感电状态；紊乱结算或状态消失会影响四件收益。: Maintain Shock on the field. Disorder or the end of Shock can reduce the 4-piece effect’s value.
messages.初始防御力转化为初始攻击力，护盾也与防御力挂钩；防御词条有明确机制收益。: Initial DEF converts to initial ATK, and the shield also scales with DEF. DEF substats therefore have a clear mechanical purpose.
messages.提高护盾值，并利用队伍的招架或回避支援提供全队增伤。: Increase shield strength and use the squad’s Defensive or Evasive Assists to provide a team damage bonus.
messages.需队伍实际发动招架支援或回避支援；同名四件增益不叠加。: The squad must actually use Defensive Assist or Evasive Assist. Effects from the same 4-piece set do not stack.
messages.展旗的攻击力分享按苍角初始攻击力计算；核心满级时未翻倍部分上限500，对应初始攻: Soukaku’s banner shares ATK based on her initial ATK. At maximum Core level, the undoubled share caps at 500, requiring 2,500 initial ATK.
messages.达到技能所需的初始攻击力后继续堆攻击不会无限提高对应分享或护盾；需检查技能等级及: ATK beyond the skill’s initial-ATK requirement does not increase its share or shield indefinitely. Check the actual skill level and cap.
messages.蓄力攻击与失衡窗口服务于击破职责，6号冲击力优先于按强攻堆攻击。: Charged attacks and the Stun window serve the Stun role. Prioritize slot 6 Impact over building ATK like an Attack Agent.
messages.加油！按初始攻击力和强化特殊技等级提供攻击分享，上限600；所需攻击面板随技能等: Lucy’s shared ATK buff depends on initial ATK and EX Special Attack level, with a cap of 600. Required ATK changes with skill level; one fixed threshold does not fit every setup.
messages.冲击力既帮助击破，也能提高昂扬提供的冰、火增伤；额外增益须满足对应队伍条件。: Impact helps Stun and also increases the Ice/Fire damage buff. The extra buff requires the relevant team conditions.
messages.能量消耗转为燃点，余烬受异常精通和攻击力影响；后台余烬被视为支援攻击。: Energy consumption generates stacks; off-field damage scales with Anomaly Proficiency and ATK and is classified as Assist Attack damage.
messages.两件提供异常精通，四件提供火、电伤害及有条件的强化特殊技、支援攻击增益。: The 2-piece effect gives Anomaly Proficiency. The 4-piece effect provides Fire/Electric DMG and conditional bonuses to EX Special Attacks and Assist Attacks.
messages.后场招式增益换入前场后只保留5秒，不能按常驻20%伤害计算。: The off-field move bonus persists for only 5 seconds after entering the field. Do not treat it as a permanent 20% damage bonus.
messages.以感电与异常积蓄为方向，异常精通和攻击力是此参考的核心输出词条。: This reference focuses on Shock and Anomaly Buildup, with Anomaly Proficiency and ATK as its main damage substats.
messages.核心已对指定招式提供大量暴击伤害；配装时须连同音擎、套装检查最终暴击率。: The Core already gives the specified moves substantial CRIT DMG. Check final CRIT Rate together with the W-Engine and set bonuses.
messages.冰伤及普攻、冲刺攻击增益契合冰属性前场输出。: Ice DMG and bonuses to Basic Attacks/Dash Attacks suit on-field Ice damage.
messages.四件额外增益需要队伍施加冻结或触发碎冰，且只持续12秒。: The additional 4-piece bonus requires the squad to inflict Freeze or trigger Shatter, and lasts only 12 seconds.
messages.飞弦·斩具有额外25%暴击率，并依赖暴击获得锋芒；计算这类招式时避免继续堆到溢出: The specified slash gains 25% CRIT Rate and generates stacks through critical hits. Avoid overcapping when calculating this move.
messages.追加攻击、冲刺攻击增伤，并由同属性的这两类攻击叠加攻击力和暴击率。: Boosts Aftershock and Dash Attack damage; matching-Attribute attacks of those types build ATK and CRIT Rate stacks.
messages.要确认招式被技能说明归为追加攻击或冲刺攻击，且伤害属性与装备者一致；同一招式最多: Confirm that the skill text classifies the move as an Aftershock or Dash Attack, and that its damage Attribute matches the equipper’s. One move can add at most 1 stack.
messages.穿透率分享取决于丽娜自身穿透率，优先检查5号穿透率和两件河豚；暴击、攻击不会提高: Rina’s PEN Ratio share depends on her own PEN Ratio. Check slot 5 PEN Ratio and the Puffer Electro 2-piece effect first. CRIT and ATK do not increase that share.
messages.异常精通、攻击力与异常掌控服务于感电和紊乱方向；循环可能频繁改变感电状态，套装覆: Anomaly Proficiency, ATK, and Anomaly Mastery support Shock and Disorder. The rotation may repeatedly remove or replace Shock, so set uptime needs practical checking.
messages.强化霰弹与失衡窗口是主要机制；额外能力触发时提供30%暴击率，需连同音擎、套装检: Enhanced Shotshells and the Stun window are central. Additional Ability grants 30% CRIT Rate when activated; include the W-Engine and sets when checking for overcap.
messages.以太伤害与暴击伤害适合以太直伤输出；队伍侵蚀伤害可继续叠加暴击伤害。: Ether DMG and CRIT DMG suit direct Ether damage. The squad’s Corruption damage can build additional CRIT DMG stacks.
messages.额外层数依赖侵蚀伤害与8秒覆盖，不能只因代理人为以太属性就视为满层。: Additional stacks require Corruption damage and have an 8-second window. An Ether Agent alone does not guarantee full stacks.
messages.冲击力服务于击破；额外能力还能将超过120的冲击力转为攻击，核心满级时最多转化6: Impact supports Stun. Additional Ability also converts Impact above 120 into ATK, granting up to 600 ATK at maximum Core level.
messages.啮咬使强击可暴击，其暴击率来自异常精通；这不是普通暴击率词条对强击的加成。: The specified effect allows Assault to CRIT, with its CRIT Rate derived from Anomaly Proficiency. Ordinary CRIT Rate substats do not supply this Assault CRIT Rate.
messages.护盾按初始攻击力计算，护盾存在时提供异常精通；不能按防护职业一律堆防御。: The shield scales with initial ATK and grants Anomaly Proficiency while present. A Defense specialty does not automatically mean building DEF.
messages.物理异常积蓄和强击为本参考方向，优先异常精通、攻击力并检查6号异常掌控。: This reference focuses on Physical Anomaly Buildup and Assault. Prioritize Anomaly Proficiency and ATK, and check Anomaly Mastery in slot 6.
messages.决算依赖失衡窗口，换入前场的短爆发可利用激素朋克；暗渊回响另有12%暴击率、25: The finishing damage depends on the Stun window, while a short on-field burst can use Hormone Punk. The Core state separately gives 12% CRIT Rate and 25% CRIT DMG.
messages.换入前场时获得限时攻击力增益，可覆盖短时爆发。: A temporary ATK bonus on entering the field can cover a short burst.
messages.增益持续10秒、触发间隔20秒；连续站场不等于全程覆盖。: The buff lasts 10 seconds with a 20-second trigger interval. Staying on field does not guarantee full uptime.
messages.多种招式明确视为追加攻击；初始能量自动回复还提高准星聚焦的攻击分享，6号能量具有: Several moves are explicitly classified as Aftershocks. Initial Energy Regen also increases the ATK share, giving slot 6 Energy Regen a functional benefit.
messages.攻击分享按初始攻击力的35%计算，核心满级时上限1200；能量关系到咏叹华彩与震: The ATK share is 35% of initial ATK, capped at 1,200 at maximum Core level. Energy affects the relevant buff and attack rotation.
messages.攻击两件与快速支援带来的嘉音适合频繁触发快速支援的队伍。: The ATK 2-piece effect and Quick Assist-triggered stacks suit teams that trigger Quick Assists frequently.
messages.四件增益作用于通过快速支援入场的角色；最多3层，同名增益不叠加。: The 4-piece buff affects the Agent entering through Quick Assist. It has up to 3 stacks, and effects with the same name do not stack.
messages.牵缠禁制提供25%暴击率，额外能力在自身暴击率达到80%时强化连携、终结技；按战: The Core state provides 25% CRIT Rate. Additional Ability strengthens Chain Attack and Ultimate at 80% CRIT Rate; check that threshold under the actual combat conditions.
messages.提供暴击率，并由普攻、闪避反击、强化特殊技暴击触发攻击增益。: Provides CRIT Rate and grants ATK buffs when Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, or EX Special Attack scores a critical hit.
messages.三种招式的增益分别计时；只使用一种招式不会自动获得三层。: The three move types have separate buff timers. Using one type does not automatically grant all three stacks.
messages.以太异常方向同时使用异常精通、攻击力和异常掌控，并能利用队友强化特殊技触发的法厄: The Ether Anomaly build uses Anomaly Proficiency, ATK, and Anomaly Mastery, and can benefit from Phaethon’s Melody when teammates use EX Special Attacks.
messages.异常掌控两件与全队强化特殊技触发的异常精通适合异常相关机制。: The Anomaly Mastery 2-piece effect and Anomaly Proficiency triggered by squad EX Special Attacks support Anomaly mechanics.
messages.四件以太增伤仅在其他队友发动强化特殊技时获得；装备者自己发动只获得异常精通。: The 4-piece Ether DMG bonus requires another teammate’s EX Special Attack. The equipper’s own EX Special Attack only grants Anomaly Proficiency.
messages.初始最大生命值提高自身暴击率，并决定额外能力的全队增伤；客户端明确27000初始: Initial Max HP increases personal CRIT Rate and determines Additional Ability’s team damage bonus. The client explicitly caps that bonus at 27,000 initial HP.
messages.先检查初始生命门槛，满足后再考虑循环或个人输出；生命达标不等于所有队伍都需要同一: Check the initial HP threshold first, then consider rotation or personal damage. Meeting the HP threshold does not mean every team needs identical main stats.
messages.猎步强化失衡值，额外能力提高队伍追加攻击伤害；四件如影提供补充输出，6号仍先保留: The enhanced moves support Daze, while Additional Ability increases team Aftershock damage. Shadow Harmony adds personal damage; retain Impact in slot 6 first.
messages.额外能力将超过40%的暴击率转为追加攻击失衡值，最多提高75%；因此暴击率也是击: Additional Ability converts CRIT Rate above 40% into Aftershock Daze, up to a 75% increase. CRIT Rate therefore also supports Stun.
messages.追加攻击是明确的伤害类型，银星增益还随自身暴击伤害提高；额外能力提供10%暴击率: Aftershock is the explicitly specified damage type. The buff also scales with personal CRIT DMG, and Additional Ability grants 10% CRIT Rate.
messages.初始攻击力决定虎啸的额外暴击伤害分享：核心满级时从2800以上继续增长，到340: Initial ATK determines the extra shared CRIT DMG. At maximum Core level, scaling begins above 2,800 and reaches the additional 30% cap at 3,400.
messages.使用山大王4件套时，先达到50%暴击率以触发额外15%全队暴击伤害；超过该门槛的: With the King of the Summit 4-piece set, first reach 50% CRIT Rate for the additional 15% team CRIT DMG. CRIT Rate above that threshold mainly adds personal damage; it does not keep increasing this set buff.
messages.失衡值两件与击破角色触发的全队暴击伤害适合直伤队击破位。: The Daze 2-piece effect and team CRIT DMG triggered by a Stun Agent suit the Stun slot in a direct-damage team.
messages.四件只供击破角色触发；额外15%暴击伤害要求装备者暴击率至少50%，同名增益不叠: Only a Stun Agent can trigger the 4-piece effect. The extra 15% CRIT DMG requires at least 50% CRIT Rate, and effects with the same name do not stack.
messages.异常掌控超过140后转为异常精通；6号异常掌控同时服务积蓄与精通。: Anomaly Mastery above 140 converts to Anomaly Proficiency. Slot 6 Anomaly Mastery therefore supports both buildup and Proficiency.
messages.初始攻击力达到3000可使狸之愿攻击分享达到上限；额外能力还随异常掌控提高，20: 3,000 initial ATK caps the ATK share. Additional Ability also scales with Anomaly Mastery, reaching its corresponding cap at 200 Mastery.
messages.通窍按初始攻击力的18%提供贯穿力，核心满级时上限540；攻击型辅助参考与其防护: The buff grants Sheer Force equal to 18% of initial ATK, capped at 540 at maximum Core level. An ATK-based support build is compatible with the Defense specialty.
messages.自身开启以太帷幕，适配沧浪行歌；合道提供30%暴击率，需将帷幕内额外暴击率一起计: The Agent creates an Ether Veil and can use White Water Ballad. The Core state gives 30% CRIT Rate; include the Veil’s additional CRIT Rate in the budget.
messages.物理伤害与以太帷幕内的暴击率配合叶瞬光自身开启帷幕的机制。: Physical DMG and CRIT Rate within an Ether Veil complement Ye Shunguang’s ability to create a Veil.
messages.四件额外暴击率、攻击力要求装备者为强攻并实际开启或延长帷幕。: The 4-piece effect’s extra CRIT Rate and ATK require an Attack Agent to actually create or extend an Ether Veil.
messages.合唱的贯穿力分享、终结技治疗均与生命相关；强化特殊技说明明确24000初始生命达: Sheer Force sharing and Ultimate healing scale with HP. The EX Special Attack text explicitly caps its share at 24,000 initial HP.
messages.强化普攻和终结技，且与另一位强攻共同维持明攻、强袭；套装选择按实际前场普攻覆盖检: The build strengthens Basic Attacks and Ultimate while maintaining buffs with another Attack Agent. Choose sets based on actual on-field Basic Attack coverage.
messages.初始暴击率超过50%的部分转为冲击力；强化特殊技循环又关系到好评与队友终结技，因: Initial CRIT Rate above 50% converts to Impact. The EX Special Attack rotation also affects team mechanics and teammates’ Ultimates, so check both CRIT Rate and Energy.
messages.天使协律按初始攻击力分享攻击，客户端明确3500初始攻击达到1050分享上限；优: The team ATK share scales with initial ATK. The client explicitly gives a 1,050 share cap at 3,500 initial ATK; prioritize that threshold and the skill rotation.
messages.异放伤害结算比例随初始异常掌控提高，不能只看异常精通就忽略6号异常掌控。: Abloom’s damage scaling increases with initial Anomaly Mastery. Focusing only on Anomaly Proficiency can overlook slot 6 Anomaly Mastery.
messages.以太伤害、普攻命中后的异常精通及敌人失衡时的增伤契合爱芮。: Ether DMG, Anomaly Proficiency after Basic Attack hits, and increased damage against Stunned enemies suit Aria.
messages.异常精通需普攻命中维持，另一增伤需敌人实际进入失衡状态。: Maintain the Anomaly Proficiency effect with Basic Attack hits. The other damage bonus requires the enemy to actually be Stunned.
messages.初始异常掌控超过110的部分转为冲击力，且角色参与异常和异放；不能机械使用所有击: Initial Anomaly Mastery above 110 converts to Impact, and the Agent contributes to Anomaly and Abloom. Do not mechanically use the same CRIT setup for every Stun Agent.
messages.先核对6号异常掌控及其转化后的冲击力，再检查套装覆盖与技能等级；副词条主要补充个: Check slot 6 Anomaly Mastery and its converted Impact first, then set uptime and skill levels. Substats mainly add personal damage; their count alone does not measure Stun performance.
messages.初始能量自动回复能提高全队电伤无视防御效果，6号能量并非仅为充能；同时保留攻击、: Initial Energy Regen improves the squad’s Electric DMG DEF-ignore effect. Slot 6 Energy Regen does more than recharge Energy; ATK and CRIT still support personal damage.
messages.初始异常掌控超过150后提高自身异常精通及全队异放伤害，6号异常掌控有明确双重机: Initial Anomaly Mastery above 150 increases personal Anomaly Proficiency and team Abloom DMG. Slot 6 Anomaly Mastery has two explicit mechanical benefits.
messages.冰伤、异放后的异常精通与冻结后的异常增伤契合普罗米娅。: Ice DMG, Anomaly Proficiency after Abloom, and Anomaly damage after Freeze suit Promeia.
messages.异放与冻结是两个不同触发条件，需分别触发并保持各自增益。: Abloom and Freeze are separate triggers. Activate each and maintain its respective buff.
messages.以太属性直伤角色，核心与终结技提供暴击伤害；拂晓行纪的以太限制和技能触发均可对应: For this direct Ether damage Agent, the Core and Ultimate provide CRIT DMG. The Sky Ablaze’s Ether restriction and skill triggers align with the kit.
messages.为以太代理人提供暴击伤害，并由强化特殊技或终结技维持攻击增益。: Provides CRIT DMG to an Ether Agent and maintains an ATK buff through EX Special Attack or Ultimate.
messages.暴击伤害要求装备者是以太属性，攻击增益需实际施放技能维持。: The CRIT DMG requires an Ether equipper. Actual skill use is needed to maintain the ATK buff.
messages.初始能量自动回复超过1.2后提高伤害与异常掌控，6号能量自动回复是技能缩放项，不: Initial Energy Regen above 1.2 increases damage and Anomaly Mastery. Slot 6 Energy Regen is a skill-scaling stat; an Anomaly Mastery disc is not automatically correct.
messages.6号能量自动回复同时影响技能循环，并通过核心提高伤害与异常掌控；先检查初始能量自: Slot 6 Energy Regen affects both the rotation and the Core’s damage/Mastery conversion. Check initial Energy Regen and the buff caps first, then assess the team rotation.
messages.风伤与强化特殊技触发的异常精通配合维琳娜的风属性异常机制。: Wind DMG and Anomaly Proficiency triggered by EX Special Attack suit Velina’s Wind Anomaly mechanics.
messages.四件另一增伤要求装备者实际触发风化。: The 4-piece effect’s other damage bonus requires the equipper to actually trigger Windswept.
messages.初始暴击率超过50后提高暴击伤害及指定技能失衡值；能量循环与这些技能的使用频率需: Initial CRIT Rate above 50% increases CRIT DMG and Daze for the specified skills. Check the Energy rotation and how often those skills can be used.
messages.异化系数和耀变倍率随异常精通提高；攻击分享又按初始攻击力与队伍异常人数计算，不能: Anomaly Proficiency affects the conversion and damage multipliers. ATK sharing also depends on initial ATK and the number of Anomaly teammates; do not choose discs using only Lumiflux damage.
messages.6号在攻击力与能量自动回复之间结合队伍异常人数和循环选择；攻击力分享按初始攻击力: Choose ATK or Energy Regen in slot 6 according to the number of Anomaly teammates and the rotation. The ATK share uses initial ATK and caps at 1,600; personal damage is not the only consideration.
messages.当前客户端5号盘主属性库没有流明伤害主词条，本参考不虚构该选项。: The current client’s slot 5 main stat pool has no Lumiflux DMG main stat. This reference does not invent that option.
messages.异常精通与非操作角色时持续持有的增益配合蕾米埃尔的流明异常机制。: Anomaly Proficiency and a buff maintained while off field suit Remielle’s Lumiflux Anomaly mechanics.
messages.流明专属异常增伤只对流明装备者生效；前场增益有15秒时限。: The Lumiflux-specific Anomaly damage bonus only applies to a Lumiflux equipper. The on-field buff has a 15-second limit.
messages.核心状态提供66%暴击率，配装优先核对状态覆盖和总暴击率；避免机械追加暴击率主词: The Core state provides 66% CRIT Rate. Check its uptime and total CRIT Rate before automatically adding a CRIT Rate main stat.
messages.核心依据初始能量自动回复超过1.2的部分提高攻击力与冲击力；核心F时每0.01提: The Core converts initial Energy Regen above 1.2 into ATK and Impact. At Core F, each 0.01 grants 5 ATK and 0.4 Impact, capped at 960 and 76.8 respectively. Both caps correspond to 3.12 initial Energy Regen.
messages.暴击率用于提高队伍符合属性条件的暴击伤害或锐暴伤害；核心F下100%暴击率达到该: CRIT Rate increases the team’s CRIT DMG or Laceration DMG for qualifying Attributes. At Core F, 100% CRIT Rate caps the share. ATK and CRIT DMG substats only supplement personal damage.
messages.6号优先能量自动回复；只有通过音擎、套装等达到所需初始能量回复后，才把冲击力列为: Prioritize Energy Regen in slot 6. Consider Impact only after the required initial Energy Regen is supplied by the W-Engine, sets, and other valid sources; still check the rotation.
messages.3.12门槛按核心F计算；不同核心等级上限不同。这是技能条件，不直接混入基础装备: The 3.12 threshold assumes Core F; other Core levels have different caps. This is a skill condition, not an unconditional addition to base equipment stats.
messages.团队暴击/锐暴增益需要浸染或净化触发，并受对应属性、队伍职业和持续时间限制；暴击: The team CRIT/Laceration bonus requires Contamination or Purification, with Attribute, specialty, and duration restrictions. CRIT Rate above 100% does not increase this share further.
messages.月光骑士颂只用二件能量回复；洛克茜是击破，不能触发限定支援职业的四件团队增伤。: Use Moonlight Lullaby only for its 2-piece Energy Regen. Roxy is Stun and cannot trigger its Support-only 4-piece team damage effect.
messages.5号穿透率为结合队伍再选的条件备选；个人输出副词条不能等同击破效率或团队增益。: Slot 5 PEN Ratio is a conditional alternative that depends on the team. Personal-damage substats are not the same as Stun efficiency or team buffs.
messages.摇摆爵士以能量自动回复支持核心缩放，连携/终结触发团队增伤；二件套优先补能量回复: Swing Jazz supports Core scaling through Energy Regen and grants team damage after Chain Attack/Ultimate. Use the 2-piece set to add Energy Regen first, or CRIT Rate if the current stats need it.
messages.四件增伤持续12秒且同名效果不叠加；需核对队友套装与触发覆盖。: The 4-piece damage bonus lasts 12 seconds and identical effects do not stack. Check teammates’ sets and activation coverage.
messages.月光骑士颂仅使用二件效果，不能为击破角色假设其四件支援效果。: Only Moonlight Lullaby’s 2-piece effect applies here. Do not assume its Support-only 4-piece effect works on a Stun Agent.
messages.装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。: The W-Engine effect activates when the equipper’s specialty matches the W-Engine’s specialty.
messages.基础属性 · 未计等级成长与改装: Base stats · Level growth and modification excluded
messages.丽都修葺漫谈Vol.7：体验优化篇: Ridu Renovation Talk Vol. 7: Experience Optimizations
messages.S盘主副属性库 · 正式3.2: S-Rank main stat and substat tables · Live 3.2
messages.锐化伤害使用防御力缩放；核心把每1%初始暴击伤害转为0.35%初始暴击率，因此暴: Sharp DMG scales with DEF. The Core Passive converts every 1% initial CRIT DMG into 0.35% initial CRIT Rate, giving CRIT Rate, DEF, and CRIT DMG distinct mechanical roles.
messages.暴击率超过100%后仍可参与额外锐暴判定；普通暴击伤害不直接提高锐化暴击伤害，而: CRIT Rate above 100% can still contribute to an additional Laceration check. Normal CRIT DMG does not directly raise Sharp critical damage; its initial-stat conversion provides CRIT Rate instead.
messages.荆棘玫瑰提供防御、通用伤害和达到初始防御门槛后的暴击率，契合防御缩放与锐暴判定；: Thorned Rose provides DEF, general DMG, and CRIT Rate at initial-DEF thresholds, fitting DEF scaling and Laceration checks. Choose CRIT Rate or PEN Ratio for the 2-piece set.
messages.四件暴击增益需初始防御达到1000/1800。: The 4-piece CRIT bonus requires 1,000/1,800 initial DEF.
messages.穿透二件套收益需结合队伍；多个二件选项只选一组。: The PEN 2-piece set’s value depends on the team. Choose only one 2-piece option.
messages.上述暴伤转换、核心状态暴击和锐暴均为角色技能机制，未作为无条件加成混入基础装备面: The CRIT DMG conversion, state-dependent Core CRIT bonus, and Laceration are skill mechanics; they are not mixed into base equipment stats as unconditional bonuses.
messages.荆棘玫瑰的暴击增益分别要求初始防御达到1000/1800；主属性选择需结合等级、: Thorned Rose’s CRIT bonuses require 1,000/1,800 initial DEF respectively. Main stat choices depend on level, W-Engine, sets, and teammates; no single universally optimal build is claimed.
messages.5号穿透率仅作条件备选；需结合队伍减防、穿透和其他增益判断。攻击力词条不作为该防: Slot 5 PEN Ratio is only a conditional alternative; evaluate team DEF reduction, PEN, and other bonuses. ATK rolls are not useful for this DEF-scaling build.
messages.锐暴伤害、锐能自动累积和锐能获得效率不是当前驱动盘可刷的副词条，不加入有效份数统: Laceration DMG, Automatic Sharpness Accumulation, and Sharpness Generation Rate are not currently obtainable Drive Disc substats and do not count toward useful rolls.
messages.这是依据正式技能与套装触发条件整理的机制参考，未验证不同影画、音擎、队伍和敌人下: This mechanics reference follows live skills and set activation conditions. Maximum damage across different Mindscapes, W-Engines, teams, and enemies has not been verified.
messages.暴击128.9%限定专武方案；来源另建议计入核心、音擎、队友后靠近200%。: The 128.9% CRIT Rate reference assumes the signature W-Engine. The source also suggests approaching 200% after Core Skill, W-Engine, and teammate effects.
messages.该角色暴伤会转换为暴击，超过100%暴击仍有机制收益；不能采用通用100%封顶。: This Agent converts CRIT DMG into CRIT Rate and benefits mechanically above 100% CRIT Rate. A generic 100% cap does not apply.
messages.每1%初始暴伤=>0.35%初始暴率: Every 1% initial CRIT DMG → 0.35% initial CRIT Rate
messages.锐化伤害不使用普通暴伤作暴击倍率；超过100%暴率仍能用于额外锐暴判定。: Sharp DMG does not use ordinary CRIT DMG as its critical multiplier. CRIT Rate above 100% still contributes to an additional Laceration check.
messages.防御缩放锐化伤害，初始暴伤以0.35转初始暴击，超过100%仍有第二次锐暴判定: DEF-scaling Sharp DMG; initial CRIT DMG converts to initial CRIT Rate at 0.35. Rate above 100% contributes to a second Laceration check.
messages.战斗队友临时暴伤不能自动再次转初始暴击，穿透与防御/电伤5号受队伍减防/丽娜影响: Temporary teammate CRIT DMG in combat is not automatically converted again into initial CRIT Rate. Slot 5 PEN versus DEF/Electric DMG depends on team DEF reduction and Rina.
messages.核心F；猩红铭刻或列明的连携/终结/反制支援/支援突击期间。: Core Skill F; during the specified state, Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up.
messages.适配专武技能的直接暴击加成，可用于锐暴预算；显示层需核。: Direct CRIT Rate from the matching signature W-Engine can contribute to a Laceration budget. The display layer needs checking.
messages.· 条件备选，需核对角色与队伍需求: · Conditional alternative; check Agent and squad requirements
messages.配队前提尚未满足 / 确认。: Squad requirements are not yet met or confirmed.
messages.表中为基础装备面板估算。: The table estimates base equipment stats.
messages.· 部分组合未完成搜索: · Some combinations have not finished searching
