messages.仅换这一盘、其余装备保持当前时：: When replacing only this disc and leaving other equipment unchanged:
messages.；其余指定目标仍需随机生成并达标。: ; the remaining target stats still need to roll randomly and meet the requirements.
messages.击破优先冲击和落雷/强化特殊技循环: Prioritize Impact and the Thunderbolt/EX Special Attack rotation for Stun.
messages.M4回复能量取决于能量获得效率，不能将能量自动回复同义代入。山大王50%暴击仅在: M4 Energy restoration depends on Energy Generation Rate, which is different from Energy Regen. The 50% CRIT Rate requirement applies only when using the King of the Summit 4-piece set.
messages.背击专武、闪避反击/快速支援的增伤窗口需要覆盖: Maintain the activation windows for the signature W-Engine’s rear attacks and Dodge Counter/Quick Assist damage bonuses.
messages.M4强化特殊技后分层加暴击，M6分层加暴伤，不能套0影固定暴击上限。: M4 adds CRIT Rate in stages after an EX Special Attack, and M6 adds CRIT DMG in stages. A fixed M0 CRIT Rate budget cannot be reused unchanged.
messages.减防和以太增伤由技能等级与短持续窗口决定: DEF reduction and Ether DMG buffs depend on skill level and short activation windows.
messages.M6给被标记敌人的暴击加成影响队友配盘，但不等于全场角色常驻面板暴击。: M6’s CRIT Rate bonus against marked enemies can affect teammates’ builds. It is not a permanent CRIT Rate increase on every Agent’s stat sheet.
messages.火力镇压与对失衡目标的加成分开: Keep Fire Suppression and bonuses against Stunned enemies separate.
messages.炎狱四件须有灼烧覆盖，不能仅因角色为火属性就预先扣28%暴击。硫磺石攻击层数并非: Inferno Metal’s 4-piece effect requires Burning. Do not deduct 28% CRIT Rate simply because the Agent is Fire. The Brimstone’s ATK stacks are not permanent initial ATK.
messages.最大生命转贯穿力，冰贯穿伤害忽略防御: Max HP converts to Sheer Force; Ice Sheer DMG ignores DEF.
messages.低血量条件同时影响核心增伤、额外能力暴伤及海妖摇篮暴击，必须输入并核触发窗口。: Low-HP requirements affect the Core damage bonus, Additional Ability CRIT DMG, and signature W-Engine CRIT Rate. Enter and verify their activation windows.
messages.电锯持续攻击及失衡窗口决定收益: Sustained chainsaw attacks and the Stun window determine the benefit.
messages.家政员的后台回能与1秒物伤层数分开，不可用后台回能满足任意初始回能门槛。: Housekeeper’s off-field Energy Regen and its 1-second Physical DMG stacks are separate effects. Off-field regeneration cannot automatically satisfy an initial Energy Regen requirement.
messages.以物理异常队的个人异常贡献为补充方向，6号仍保留冲击功能。: Personal Anomaly contribution in a Physical Anomaly team is a secondary focus; slot 6 still retains Impact for its Stun role.
messages.异常副词条的好坏不能直接代表护盾/击破/辅助功能等级。: Anomaly substat quality does not directly measure shield, Stun, or support performance.
messages.若装备山大王且角色为击破，额外团队暴伤仍需单独检查50%暴击。: If a Stun Agent equips King of the Summit, separately check the 50% CRIT Rate requirement for its extra team CRIT DMG.
messages.以个人直伤为补充方向，6号冲击及核心功能先保留。: Direct personal damage is a secondary focus. Retain slot 6 Impact and the Agent’s Core function first.
messages.作者双暴建议是补充伤害，不把固定双暴份数当作护盾或击破毕业要求。: The author’s CRIT recommendations add personal damage. A fixed CRIT roll count is not a shield or Stun completion requirement.
messages.荣光之盾用初始冲击缩放，固定攻击分享不随自身攻击提高: The shield scales with initial Impact; the fixed ATK share does not increase with the Agent’s own ATK.
messages.M2提高分享效果而非提高所需冲击门槛。M6必暴招式和15秒通用双暴分开。: M2 strengthens the shared buff rather than increasing the required Impact. Keep M6’s guaranteed-CRIT moves separate from its 15-second general CRIT bonuses.
messages.蹲姿增伤会随移动等结束: The crouching damage bonus ends when conditions such as movement break the stance.
messages.M4距离暴击只覆盖强化特殊技，与专武要求6米外命中的条件可能要求不同操作窗口。: M4’s distance-based CRIT Rate only affects EX Special Attack. Its activation window may differ from the signature W-Engine’s requirement to hit from more than 6 meters away.
messages.80%暴击只封顶烈霜积蓄加成: 80% CRIT Rate only caps the Frost buildup bonus.
messages.M2的进场15%暴击、折枝冻结后暴击和专武暴伤须按各自口径计入，不抹掉80%以上: Account separately for M2’s 15% entry CRIT Rate, Branch & Blade Song’s post-Freeze CRIT Rate, and the signature W-Engine’s CRIT DMG. CRIT Rate above 80% can still benefit direct damage.
messages.专武强化特殊技后冲击与后台回能均有条件: The signature W-Engine’s post-EX Impact and off-field Energy Regen both have activation conditions.
messages.M2能量返还改变循环，不能把相同回能盘永久判作最优。搭配本的联合技不是自由常驻增: M2’s Energy refund changes the rotation, so the same Energy Regen disc is not always optimal. Joint attacks with Ben are not an unconditional permanent buff.
messages.追加感电需要爆发状态、感电目标及暴击次数: Additional Shock triggers require Burst state, a Shocked target, and the required number of critical hits.
messages.M4团队10%暴击为12秒窗口。不能用普通暴击伤害代替感电本身的伤害构成。: M4’s 10% team CRIT Rate lasts 12 seconds. Ordinary CRIT DMG does not replace the damage calculation for Shock itself.
messages.角色按个人伤害培养，区别现有护盾防御方案。: This is a personal-damage build, distinct from the existing DEF-based shield build.
messages.16%暴击队伍加成要求额外能力激活且持有本核心提供的护盾。: The 16% team CRIT Rate bonus requires an active Additional Ability and the shield supplied by Ben’s Core Passive.
messages.火属性伤害主属性不覆盖普通攻击的物理段；穿透的具体收益受敌人及减防队友影响。: A Fire DMG main stat does not boost the Physical hits of Basic Attack. PEN’s benefit depends on the enemy and teammates’ DEF reduction.
messages.四件炎狱需要灼烧覆盖；四件河豚在作者的琉音连携转终结技队伍中成立，不能泛化。: Inferno Metal’s 4-piece effect requires Burning. Puffer Electro’s 4-piece recommendation comes from the author’s Dialyn team that converts a Chain Attack into an Ultimate; it is not universal.
messages.比格气缸额外伤害的必暴只覆盖该额外伤害，不能把整套暴击率收益设为0。: Big Cylinder’s guaranteed CRIT only applies to its additional damage. It does not make CRIT Rate worthless for the entire build.
messages.防御转初始攻击与护盾缩放可复用，但输出流派存在明确双暴/火伤或穿透/攻击方案。比: DEF-to-initial-ATK conversion and shield scaling still apply, but the damage build has explicit CRIT/Fire DMG or PEN/ATK options. Big Cylinder’s guaranteed-CRIT extra damage does not make every move a guaranteed CRIT.
messages.先满足当前核心等级攻击分享门槛及展旗循环，不能因改用暴击4号而丢失必要攻击。: Meet the current Core level’s ATK-sharing threshold and maintain banner uptime first. A CRIT main stat in slot 4 must not remove the required ATK.
messages.双暴为作者的可选个人输出方向，不是队伍分享的硬性毕业线。: CRIT is the author’s optional personal-damage direction, not a mandatory threshold for the shared team buff.
messages.终结技15%暴击需另核15秒窗口。: Check the Ultimate’s additional 15% CRIT Rate within its separate 15-second window.
messages.核心F攻击分享输入2500，满门槛后可选双暴补输出: At Core F, 2,500 ATK reaches the ATK-sharing input threshold. CRIT may then supplement personal damage.
messages.终结技额外15%暴击为15秒，M6改变强化普攻使用次数，不能仍用纯辅助目标评个人: The Ultimate’s additional 15% CRIT Rate lasts 15 seconds. M6 changes the number of enhanced Basic Attacks, so personal damage needs more than a pure-support target.
messages.蓄力普攻击破、冰抗降低和失衡易伤是独立功能: Charged Basic Attack Daze, Ice RES reduction, and Stun vulnerability are separate functions.
messages.副词条攻击与双暴只补输出，山大王50%只随所选四件触发。: ATK and CRIT substats add personal damage. The 50% CRIT Rate target only applies when the selected King of the Summit 4-piece effect needs it.
messages.先按特殊技真实等级满足加油分享门槛和覆盖，不能统一固定600所需攻击。: Use the actual Special Attack level to determine the ATK needed for the shared buff and its uptime. Do not assume one fixed ATK requirement for a 600-point buff.
messages.小猪继承双暴要求额外能力激活；无此条件不能声称双暴提高小猪伤害。: The boars inherit CRIT only when Additional Ability is active. Without it, CRIT cannot be claimed to increase their damage.
messages.作者双暴范围为可选输出参考，不能据此单独否定辅助合格。: The author’s CRIT ranges are optional damage references. Missing them alone does not invalidate the Agent’s support build.
messages.加油门槛取真实特殊技等级，M3/M5影响12/14/16但不提高核心F: The shared ATK threshold uses the actual Special Attack level. M3/M5 change it to level 12/14/16 without increasing Core F.
messages.额外能力激活后小猪继承双暴，故达分享门槛后存在暴击4号的输出补充方案。: With Additional Ability active, the boars inherit CRIT. After meeting the sharing threshold, a CRIT slot 4 becomes an optional personal-damage choice.
messages.昂扬满20层的270冲击取效果时冲击，须计自身士气和专武支援后的冲击窗口: The 270 Impact threshold for 20 stacks uses Impact at activation. Include the Agent’s own buff and the signature W-Engine’s post-Assist Impact window.
messages.M2加强最终增益不把270输入门槛乘1.2。: M2 strengthens the final buff. It does not multiply the 270 Impact input threshold by 1.2.
messages.余烬的精通增伤在300封顶但属性异常继续吃精通: The Anomaly Proficiency damage bonus caps at 300, but Attribute Anomaly damage continues to benefit from Anomaly Proficiency.
messages.M4只给强化特殊技/支援攻击暴击，不把角色整体改判双暴: M4 only adds CRIT Rate to EX Special Attack/Assist attacks. It does not turn the entire Agent into a CRIT build.
messages.M2目标穿透与专武后台回能会改队伍收益。: M2’s target PEN effect and the signature W-Engine’s off-field Energy Regen can change team value.
messages.电能消耗提升特定技能异常积蓄，感电增益要求强化特殊技命中及下一次感电: Energy consumption increases specific skills’ Anomaly Buildup. The Shock buff requires EX Special Attack to hit and applies to the next Shock.
messages.专武精通三层各自计时，不能并入初始面板。: The signature W-Engine’s three Anomaly Proficiency stacks have separate timers. They cannot be folded into initial stats.
messages.核心100%暴伤只覆盖指定冰蓄力/强化普攻: The Core’s 100% CRIT DMG only applies to the specified charged/enhanced Ice Basic Attacks.
messages.M1最多12%暴击及专武两个独立条件暴击要避免溢出，专武R5两项各20%，不能按: Avoid overcapping after M1’s up to 12% CRIT Rate and the signature W-Engine’s two independent CRIT conditions. At R5, each W-Engine effect gives 20%; do not assume a linearly scaled 32% total.
messages.25%暴击只覆盖飞弦·斩: The 25% CRIT Rate bonus only applies to the specified move.
messages.专武无前置暴击与异常/失衡后暴击分开，M1提高锋芒层数不意味着所有招式获得同样暴: Separate the signature W-Engine’s unconditional CRIT Rate from its bonus after Anomaly/Stun. M1’s higher stack count does not give every move the same CRIT DMG.
messages.穿透分享输入72%为理论封顶而非所有配装必达，M1改变分享效果及范围窗口: 72% PEN Ratio is the theoretical cap for the sharing input, not a mandatory target for every build. M1 changes the shared effect and its coverage window.
messages.需区分原技能和潜能觉醒后的技能，不能默认额外防御分享已启用。: Distinguish the original skill from its Potential Awakening version. Do not assume the extra DEF share is active.
messages.专武375异常精通是其紊乱增伤触发门槛，包含满足条件的专武临时精通时再比较: The signature W-Engine’s 375 Anomaly Proficiency requirement activates its Disorder DMG bonus. Compare after including its temporary Proficiency only when that condition is active.
messages.M1洞悉精通80取有层数时，不直接冲抵静态精通。: M1’s 80 Anomaly Proficiency requires its stacks. Do not deduct it from the static Proficiency target unconditionally.
messages.额外能力30%暴击须合格队友与10秒招式触发: Additional Ability’s 30% CRIT Rate requires a qualifying teammate and a move-triggered 10-second window.
messages.专武各阶常驻技能暴击与M6妮可目标暴击分别计，不能固定套所有配置55%或70%场: Account separately for the signature W-Engine’s CRIT Rate at its actual rank and M6 Nicole’s target-specific bonus. A fixed 55% or 70% out-of-combat cap does not apply to every setup.
messages.冲击转攻击在效果时冲击220封顶: Impact-to-ATK conversion caps at 220 Impact at activation.
messages.M1只对满电招式命中目标提供20%暴击，不能拿它满足全局初始暴击或未标记目标。: M1’s 20% CRIT Rate only affects the target hit by the fully charged move. It cannot satisfy a global initial CRIT Rate requirement or apply to unmarked targets.
messages.精通同时影响狂热攻击转换和啮咬强击独立暴击，两条375/420门槛不同: Anomaly Proficiency affects both the ATK conversion and Assault’s independent CRIT check. Their 375 and 420 thresholds are separate.
messages.M1另有300精通的自身增伤封顶，M2独立强击暴伤与M6普通双暴不能混合。: M1 also has a personal damage cap at 300 Anomaly Proficiency. Do not merge M2’s independent Assault CRIT DMG with M6’s ordinary CRIT stats.
messages.3750初始攻击是核心F盾量封顶而非精通分享门槛，精通分享固定100: 3,750 initial ATK caps the Core F shield, not the Anomaly Proficiency share. The Proficiency share is a fixed 100.
messages.M1盾量和上限同比提高，输入仍3750: M1 increases shield scaling and its cap proportionally; the required input remains 3,750.
messages.M6末击必暴只覆盖该攻击。: M6’s guaranteed CRIT only applies to that final hit.
messages.强化特殊技与动力积累是主要异常方向: EX Special Attack and stack generation are the main Anomaly priorities.
messages.专武三种随机增益可以同时存在但不能默认每次全覆盖。异常掌控与攻击6号需结合异常积: All three random signature W-Engine buffs can coexist, but full uptime cannot be assumed. Choose Anomaly Mastery or ATK in slot 6 based on each Agent’s share of Anomaly Buildup.
messages.一/双击破改变核心额外攻击300/900: One or two Stun teammates change the Core’s additional ATK from 300 to 900.
messages.核心12%暴击为暗渊回响6秒，M1额外12%只在决算招式，不能合成全场24%暴击: The Core’s 12% CRIT Rate lasts 6 seconds. M1’s additional 12% only applies to its specified finishing move; they are not a permanent combined 24% CRIT Rate.
messages.初始回能3.7封顶攻击分享而非个人输出收益: 3.7 initial Energy Regen caps the ATK share, not all personal-damage benefits.
messages.核心25%与专武各阶暴击、如影12%须避免重复算，后台自动强化特殊技改变回能需要: Avoid double-counting the Core’s 25% CRIT Rate, the signature W-Engine’s rank-dependent bonus, and the set’s 12%. Automatic off-field EX Special Attacks can change Energy Regen needs.
messages.M2同时改攻击分享系数与上限，门槛降至2963而非继续3429: M2 changes both the ATK-sharing coefficient and cap. The threshold falls to 2,963 instead of remaining 3,429.
messages.M6的80%暴击仅震音/音簇和指定随想曲，普通全部攻击不能视为常驻80%。: M6’s 80% CRIT Rate only covers its specified moves. Do not apply it as a permanent 80% bonus to every attack.
messages.暴击率>=80%时指定招式伤害倍率*1.25: At CRIT Rate ≥ 80%, the specified move’s damage multiplier is multiplied by 1.25.
messages.条件核心25%暴击、80%战斗暴击招式倍率门槛、100%通常暴击上限分别判断: Evaluate the conditional 25% Core CRIT Rate, the move’s 80% in-combat CRIT Rate threshold, and the usual 100% CRIT Rate cap separately.
messages.M4护盾暴伤与专武暴伤需确认窗口。: Check the uptime of M4’s shield-based CRIT DMG and the signature W-Engine’s CRIT DMG.
messages.异放结算按精通且依赖目标异常类型，队友原始异常强度也重要: Abloom scales with Anomaly Proficiency and depends on the target’s Anomaly type. The strength of the teammate’s original Anomaly also matters.
messages.M4两招必暴和攻击12%不使属性异常整体受普通暴击词条控制。: M4’s two guaranteed-CRIT moves and 12% ATK do not make all Attribute Anomaly damage scale with ordinary CRIT stats.
messages.暴击率额外提高=初始最大生命值/1000*1.4%；M6此效果*1.25: Additional CRIT Rate = initial Max HP / 1,000 × 1.4%; M6 multiplies this conversion by 1.25.
messages.27000初始生命封顶队伍伤害分享: 27,000 initial HP caps the shared team damage bonus.
messages.初始生命转暴击与战斗临时生命分开，M6倍率1.25只提高该转换效果，不让输入生命: Keep initial-HP-to-CRIT conversion separate from temporary combat HP. M6’s 1.25 multiplier only strengthens that conversion; it does not recursively increase input HP.
messages.原作者明确异常补充/双暴补充两方案，6号均冲击: The original author offers Anomaly and CRIT damage supplements. Both keep Impact in slot 6.
messages.功能性击破不能由可选个人输出副词条评级替代，M1目标条件暴击并非全局初始暴击。: Optional personal-damage substats cannot replace assessment of the Agent’s Stun function. M1’s target-dependent CRIT Rate is not global initial CRIT Rate.
messages.90%暴击封顶追加失衡增益，取触发时的暴击而非武断全部场外: 90% CRIT Rate caps the additional Daze bonus. Use CRIT Rate at activation rather than assuming every bonus is out of combat.
messages.专武冲击需后台叠层，M2团队暴伤最多24%取猎眸窗口。: The signature W-Engine’s Impact needs off-field stacks. M2’s up to 24% team CRIT DMG depends on its buff window.
messages.玄墨贯穿伤害以贯穿力缩放并无视防御，生命转贯穿力: Auric Ink Sheer DMG scales with Sheer Force and ignores DEF. HP converts to Sheer Force.
messages.M1进场10%暴击、专武20~32%、云岿最多12%要按实际装备扣除，不给穿透词: Deduct M1’s 10% entry CRIT Rate, the signature W-Engine’s 20–32%, and the set’s up to 12% only for the actual setup. Do not score PEN substats as equally useful for this damage type.
messages.银星使追加攻击目标所受暴伤随自身暴伤提高，额外能力10%/M2另12%暴击可降低: Additional attacks increase the target’s CRIT DMG taken based on the Agent’s own CRIT DMG. Additional Ability’s 10% and M2’s additional 12% CRIT Rate can reduce the ordinary CRIT Rate budget.
messages.潜能觉醒段落不能按拥有影画自动启用。: Potential Awakening sections do not automatically activate when a Mindscape is owned.
messages.3400初始攻击封顶额外虎啸暴伤，M2再加22%不改变输入阈值: 3,400 initial ATK caps the additional CRIT DMG effect. M2’s extra 22% does not change the input threshold.
messages.M1进场12%暴击影响山大王达标预算，但不自动替换未确认的初始面板。: M1’s 12% entry CRIT Rate affects the King of the Summit threshold budget. It does not automatically replace an unverified initial stat value.
messages.异常掌控超过140转精通，专武60掌控会影响转换但不是源界面初始值: Anomaly Mastery above 140 converts to Anomaly Proficiency. The signature W-Engine’s 60 Mastery affects the conversion but is not an initial value supplied by the source interface.
messages.M6额外精通倍率攻击必暴，应保留正常属性异常与这一路伤害的区别。: M6’s extra Proficiency-scaling attack is guaranteed to CRIT. Keep it separate from normal Attribute Anomaly damage.
messages.3000初始攻击及200效果时异常掌控是两项不同分享上限: 3,000 initial ATK and 200 Anomaly Mastery at activation cap two different shared buffs.
messages.专武临时30掌控与M1增益系数不能被误作初始攻击修正或掌控门槛增加。: The signature W-Engine’s temporary 30 Mastery and M1’s buff coefficient do not modify initial ATK or increase the Mastery threshold.
messages.核心F初始攻击3000封顶贯穿分享: At Core F, 3,000 initial ATK caps the shared Sheer Force.
messages.M6系数18%→24%、上限540→720同时变化，输入门槛仍3000: At M6, the coefficient changes from 18% to 24% and the cap from 540 to 720. The input threshold remains 3,000.
messages.只把增益传给实际下一入场目标。: Apply the shared buff only to the Agent who actually enters next.
messages.合道30%暴击和沧浪两段10%分别有进场/以太帷幕条件: The 30% CRIT Rate effect and the set’s two 10% stages have separate entry/Ether Veil requirements.
messages.50%场外预算仅在所假定套装与覆盖成立时适用，不能固定对全部盘及武器。: A 50% out-of-combat CRIT Rate budget only applies when the assumed set and uptime are valid. It is not fixed for every disc and W-Engine.
messages.生命转贯穿力，熔锋10%暴击和失血专武暴击有不同持续条件: HP converts to Sheer Force. The set’s 10% CRIT Rate and the HP-loss signature W-Engine bonus have different duration requirements.
messages.耗血连斩50%暴伤只覆盖该次攻击。: The HP-consuming slash’s 50% CRIT DMG only applies to that attack.
messages.技能原文直接给24000；等级12:12+7.4*(24000/200)=900: The skill text explicitly gives 24,000. At level 12: 12 + 7.4 × (24,000 / 200) = 900.
messages.24000初始生命提供破暗分享上限，专武临时生命不能递归代入: 24,000 initial HP caps the shared buff. Temporary signature W-Engine HP cannot be fed back into the initial input.
messages.M6合唱必暴与初始生命转攻击改变副C取舍，但不把所有招式或全队标为必暴。: M6’s guaranteed-CRIT move and initial-HP-to-ATK conversion change secondary-damage priorities. They do not guarantee CRITs for every move or every teammate.
messages.需要另一位强攻，以初始攻击最高者确定正兵，候选盘甚至可能改变谁获得配对增益: Another Attack Agent is required. The one with the highest initial ATK receives the paired role; candidate discs may change which Agent qualifies.
messages.强袭/明攻的1000攻击与30%暴伤须对应释放强化特殊技和有效队友。: The 1,000 ATK and 30% CRIT DMG team buffs require the corresponding EX Special Attack and an eligible teammate.
messages.生命转贯穿力，专武20~32%暴击影响主词条预算: HP converts to Sheer Force. The signature W-Engine’s 20–32% CRIT Rate affects the main stat budget.
messages.核心36%及M2另15%暴伤是强化特殊技/支援突击触发的30秒窗口，非全场固定面: The Core’s 36% and M2’s additional 15% CRIT DMG last 30 seconds after EX Special Attack/Assist Follow-Up. They are not permanent sheet stats.
messages.初始暴击50以上转冲击至100%输入封顶，战斗临时暴击不能代替: Initial CRIT Rate above 50% converts to Impact, reaching its input cap at 100% CRIT Rate. Temporary combat CRIT Rate cannot replace initial CRIT Rate.
messages.追加伤害取队伍上一位强攻攻击或命破贯穿，不能只凭琉音个人副词条定义毕业。: Additional damage uses the previous teammate’s ATK if they are Attack, or Sheer Force if they are Rupture. Dialyn’s personal substats alone cannot define a finished build.
messages.3500初始攻击封顶分享: 3,500 initial ATK caps the shared buff.
messages.猫的凝视取触发队友属性而非统一自身双暴，M6创作8秒内自身攻击必暴并以初始攻击转: The triggered effect uses the teammate’s stats, not always the Agent’s own CRIT. M6 guarantees the Agent’s attacks to CRIT for 8 seconds and converts initial ATK into CRIT DMG; more CRIT Rate is not always the answer.
messages.核心按初始异常掌控缩放异放，M1异放独立暴率在250初始掌控到100%，不由普通: The Core scales Abloom from initial Anomaly Mastery. M1’s independent Abloom CRIT Rate reaches 100% at 250 initial Mastery; ordinary CRIT Rate substats do not replace it.
messages.专武与核心固定精通应检查实际面板是否已包含。: Check whether the displayed stats already include the signature W-Engine’s and Core’s fixed Anomaly Proficiency.
messages.初始掌控110是转换起点而非封顶，精通不是掌控: 110 initial Mastery starts the conversion; it is not a cap. Anomaly Proficiency and Anomaly Mastery are different stats.
messages.异常积蓄/失衡双条件与上一位队友、爱芮协作关系影响极性紊乱，不能统一6冲击双暴。: Anomaly Buildup/Daze requirements, the previous teammate, and cooperation with Aria affect Polarity Disorder. One Impact-slot-6 CRIT build does not fit every team.
messages.初始回能3.68封顶电伤无视防御，M1强化最终无视防御而非改变输入门槛: 3.68 initial Energy Regen caps the Electric DMG DEF-ignore effect. M1 strengthens the final effect without changing the input threshold.
messages.专武R1~5暴击25~40，其他技能/套装暴击不能漏算。: The signature W-Engine’s R1–R5 CRIT Rate ranges from 25% to 40%. Include CRIT Rate from other skills and sets as well.
messages.核心消耗生命后90%暴伤、M4最多16%与M2指定孤轮特技50%分别计算: Calculate the Core’s 90% CRIT DMG after HP consumption, M4’s up to 16%, and M2’s move-specific 50% separately.
messages.专武20~32%暴击不等于常规攻击词条可替代生命。: The signature W-Engine’s 20–32% CRIT Rate does not make ordinary ATK substats a substitute for HP.
messages.每超过150的1点=>自身异常精通+1.5、全队异放伤害+0.35%: Each point above 150 grants +1.5 personal Anomaly Proficiency and +0.35% team Abloom DMG.
messages.初始掌控150只是转换起点，向自身精通和全队异放的双转换没有原文封顶: 150 initial Mastery only starts the conversion. The original text gives no cap for the two conversions into personal Proficiency and team Abloom DMG.
messages.M2加40的是精通，M1和额外能力的异放无视防御只覆盖相应目标状态。: M2 adds 40 Anomaly Proficiency. The Abloom DEF-ignore effects from M1 and Additional Ability only cover their respective target states.
messages.额外能力40%暴伤、终结分支指定40%与M1进场8%暴击作用范围不同: Additional Ability’s 40% CRIT DMG, the specified Ultimate branch’s 40%, and M1’s 8% entry CRIT Rate have different scopes.
messages.专武R1~R5暴击始终20%，不能假定每阶递增。: The signature W-Engine gives 20% CRIT Rate at every rank from R1 to R5. Do not assume it increases with each rank.
messages.初始能量回复2.88同时覆盖伤害/掌控转换的两个上限: 2.88 initial Energy Regen reaches both caps for the damage and Anomaly Mastery conversions.
messages.临时回能不能默认计入初始: Do not automatically count temporary Energy Regen as initial Energy Regen.
messages.乱流/风化与其他属性异常的转化需要队伍条件。: Conversions between Vortex/Windswept and other Attribute Anomalies require the appropriate team conditions.
messages.初始暴击100%封顶暴伤/特定招式失衡转换: 100% initial CRIT Rate caps the CRIT DMG and specified-move Daze conversions.
messages.贯穿转攻击依赖外部贯穿分享，不能把尚未知的贯穿当0判毕业，亦不能推荐击破角色自堆: Sheer-Force-to-ATK conversion depends on external Sheer Force sharing. Do not treat an unknown share as zero when evaluating completion, or recommend that a Stun Agent build Sheer Force through discs.
messages.4000初始攻击上限只适用三异常，双异常是12%而非40%: The 4,000 initial ATK cap applies only to a three-Anomaly team. With two Anomaly Agents, the coefficient is 12%, not 40%.
messages.异常精通同时改异化系数与耀变倍率，不能让达攻击门槛抹掉精通的持续收益。: Anomaly Proficiency affects both conversion and damage multipliers. Reaching the ATK threshold does not remove its continuing value.
messages.核心66%暴击仅巡空枪势及刷新后8秒，其他来源预算34%仅该窗口: The Core’s 66% CRIT Rate only applies in its specified stance and for 8 seconds after refresh. The 34% budget from other sources only applies within that window.
messages.专武暴伤两层分别要普攻/强化特殊技重击，不能忽略不重击时的缺层。: The signature W-Engine’s two CRIT DMG stacks require the respective heavy hits from Basic Attack and EX Special Attack. Missing stacks outside those hits cannot be ignored.
messages.初始回能3.12封顶攻击/冲击转化: 3.12 initial Energy Regen caps the ATK and Impact conversions.
messages.100%效果时暴击封顶对应属性暴伤或锐暴分享，须实际触发浸染/净化并分锋御与非锋: 100% CRIT Rate at activation caps the matching Attribute’s shared CRIT DMG or Laceration DMG. Contamination/Purification must actually trigger, with Armorer and non-Armorer effects evaluated separately.
messages.尚无作者完整毕业范围。: A complete build-target range from the guide author is not yet available.
messages.0～1 影画的攻略攻击参考为 3430；本页按核心 F 换算为 3429，2 影: The guide gives 3,430 ATK at M0–M1. This page derives 3,429 at Core Skill F, or 2,963 from M2. The energy entry is bonus regen percentage, not regeneration per second.
messages.1/2异常时系数6%/12%，同样1600上限的代数输入为26666.67/13: With 1/2 Anomaly Agents, the coefficients are 6%/12%; algebraically reaching the same 1,600 cap takes 26,666.67/13,333.33 input ATK. Unrealistic cap values are not endgame recommendations.
messages.110是转换起点；原文无冲击封顶，不能写110毕业。M4增加异常精通，不是异常掌: 110 is where the conversion starts, not an Impact cap or finished-build target. M4 increases Anomaly Proficiency, not Anomaly Mastery.
messages.140是开始转换的界点；原文无封顶，不能写140即毕业。: 140 is the conversion’s starting point. The text gives no cap, so 140 is not a finished-build threshold.
messages.150为转换起点；文本未给上限。M2直接增加40精通，不能误作40掌控。: 150 is the conversion’s starting point; no cap is given. M2 directly adds 40 Anomaly Proficiency, not 40 Anomaly Mastery.
messages.2.88同时覆盖这项掌控上限与35%伤害上限。: 2.88 reaches both this Anomaly Mastery cap and the 35% DMG cap.
messages.3400攻击使核心额外暴伤分享封顶；暴击50%仅山大王四件方案需要。: 3,400 ATK caps the Core Skill’s extra shared CRIT DMG. 50% CRIT Rate is only needed for the King of the Summit 4-piece build.
messages.4000 对应三异常队伍、额外能力生效时的 1600 攻击分享上限；其他队伍人数: 4,000 ATK reaches the 1,600 shared-ATK cap with three Anomaly Agents and an active Additional Ability. Sharing ratios differ with other team counts.
messages.50%是来源场外暴击上限参考；需满足其假定的角色与四件战斗暴击效果。: 50% is the source’s out-of-combat CRIT Rate ceiling reference. It requires the assumed Agent and 4-piece combat CRIT bonuses.
messages.75%为场外参考，指定招式另有25%暴击；这不是全部招式都享有的增益。: 75% is an out-of-combat reference; specified moves receive another 25% CRIT Rate. This bonus does not apply to every move.
messages.M1把异常伤害/紊乱增益乘1.3，原输入门槛200保持。: M1 multiplies the Anomaly DMG/Disorder bonus by 1.3. The original input threshold remains 200.
messages.M1把整体无视防御效果乘1.4；不改变3.68输入上限。: M1 multiplies the overall DEF-ignore effect by 1.4. The 3.68 input cap does not change.
messages.M1近人偶10米内把分享乘1.3，输入门槛不因此改变。不是推荐所有人硬堆72%。: Within 10m of the Bangboo, M1 multiplies the shared bonus by 1.3 without changing its input threshold. This does not recommend forcing every build to 72%.
messages.M2将最终增益乘1.2，不把输入门槛乘1.2；M6额外火焰冲击上限也在270冲击: M2 multiplies the final bonus by 1.2, not the input threshold. M6’s additional fire effect also caps at 270 Impact.
messages.M2额外22%虎啸暴伤不抬高该3400门槛。: M2’s additional 22% CRIT DMG does not raise this 3,400 threshold.
messages.M6自身条件暴伤上限105/0.03=3500，仍按初始攻击。: M6’s own conditional CRIT DMG cap is 105 / 0.03 = 3,500, still using initial ATK.
messages.三异常队攻击分享上限: ATK-sharing cap in a three-Anomaly team
messages.不包含其他额外暴击增益。: Excludes other additional CRIT Rate bonuses.
messages.不等于推荐击破诺姆堆960贯穿力；队伍外部贯穿力有依赖。: This does not recommend building Stun Norm to 960 Sheer Force. It depends on external Sheer Force from the team.
messages.不能改成角色面板暴击率；M2改变该强击暴伤。: Do not replace this with the Agent’s displayed CRIT Rate. M2 changes this Assault CRIT DMG.
messages.作者在整组战前数值前明确假定1阶海妖摇篮与云岿四件；影画未注明。: The author explicitly assumes a 1-star signature W-Engine and the stated 4-piece set for the entire pre-combat stat group. Mindscape level is unspecified.
messages.先达到3000攻击再考虑个人输出；来源掌控171是装备参考，技能全增益上限应另核: Reach 3,000 ATK before considering personal damage. The source’s 171 Anomaly Mastery is an equipment reference; check 200 separately for the skill’s full-bonus threshold.
messages.公式直接来自M1，不能混为角色普通暴率；同源M1全文在cinema[0]。: The formula comes directly from M1 and is not ordinary Agent CRIT Rate. The same-source full M1 text is stored in cinema[0].
messages.冲击170–195为配装参考，不能与战斗昂扬增伤完全封顶所需冲击等同。: 170–195 Impact is a build reference, not the Impact required to fully cap the combat-state DMG bonus.
messages.冲击为主要功能属性；异常队精通/掌控与直伤队双暴应择一，50%暴击与山大王四件有: Impact is the main utility stat. Choose Anomaly stats for Anomaly teams or CRIT for direct-damage teams; 50% CRIT Rate relates to King of the Summit’s 4-piece effect.
messages.冲击力是主要功能属性；异常方向与双暴方向按队伍择一，均为补充输出。: Impact is the main utility stat. Choose either Anomaly or CRIT based on the team; both provide supplementary damage.
messages.准星聚焦攻击分享上限: ATK-sharing cap during the targeting effect
messages.原作者尚未给出毕业区间；只提供本地3.2正式核心F可推导的功能门槛，标记为机制参: The original author has not published an endgame range. Only functional thresholds derived from live 3.2 Core Skill F data are shown as mechanics references.
messages.只封顶这项余烬增伤，不封顶异常伤害总体精通收益。: Only this Ember bonus is capped; the overall Anomaly DMG value of Anomaly Proficiency is not capped here.
messages.团队暴伤 / 锐暴分享上限: Team CRIT DMG / Laceration DMG sharing cap
messages.场外33.8%是来源实际配装参考；核心66%加成后约99.8%，数学上100%需: 33.8% is the source’s actual out-of-combat build reference. Adding the Core Skill’s 66% gives about 99.8%; reaching exactly 100% requires 34%. Do not treat 33.8% as an exact hard cap.
messages.对啮咬目标的强击独立暴击。: Independent Assault CRIT check against a marked target.
messages.巡空枪势期间暴击预算: CRIT budget during the specified spear stance
messages.异常掌控184以上为基础参考；专武战斗效果另加60，不能再把这60算进场外。: 184+ Anomaly Mastery is the base reference. The signature W-Engine adds 60 in combat; do not also include that 60 in out-of-combat stats.
messages.异常精通375–420明确是战斗参考；420用于热狂攻击转换达到600上限。: 375–420 Anomaly Proficiency is explicitly an in-combat reference. 420 reaches the 600 ATK-conversion cap during the specified state.
messages.异常精通高级属性音擎；来源区间两端各加90。: For a W-Engine with Anomaly Proficiency as its advanced stat, add 90 to both ends of the source range.
messages.扣除核心后的场外暴击参考: Out-of-combat CRIT reference after subtracting the Core bonus
messages.按初始生命，不可把帷幕中临时生命再次递归代入。: Uses initial HP. Temporary HP gained inside a Veil cannot be recursively fed back into the formula.
messages.按所标技能等级读取，不随影画或叠影直接线性调整。: Read at the indicated skill level. Do not scale linearly with Mindscapes or W-Engine stars.
messages.攻击2600–3200+是实用参考；护盾的理论攻击上限为3750初始攻击，需区分: 2,600–3,200+ ATK is a practical reference. The theoretical shield cap requires 3,750 initial ATK; distinguish practical cost from reaching the cap.
messages.攻击3000用于核心分享上限；额外双暴只增加个人伤害。: 3,000 ATK reaches the Core Skill’s sharing cap. Extra CRIT only raises personal damage.
messages.攻击3500以上是来源重点；其主要伤害依赖队友属性，其他副词条不是等价毕业要求。: The source emphasizes 3,500+ ATK. Main damage depends on teammate stats; other substats are not equivalent completion requirements.
messages.攻击、暴伤为补充输出；暴击50%门槛仅使用山大王四件时适用。: ATK and CRIT DMG supplement damage. The 50% CRIT Rate requirement only applies with King of the Summit’s 4-piece effect.
messages.攻击、暴伤为补充输出；暴击50%门槛仅山大王四件适用。: ATK and CRIT DMG supplement damage. The 50% CRIT Rate requirement only applies to King of the Summit’s 4-piece effect.
messages.攻击区间受音擎选择影响。: The ATK range depends on the chosen W-Engine.
messages.攻击和暴伤为补充输出，战斗还会经冲击转换增加攻击；暴击50%门槛仅山大王四件适用: ATK and CRIT DMG supplement damage; combat ATK also increases through Impact conversion. The 50% CRIT Rate requirement only applies to King of the Summit’s 4-piece effect.
messages.攻击和精通是个人输出补充；减防幅度由技能决定，不能拿这两项定义辅助是否毕业。: ATK and Anomaly Proficiency supplement personal damage. DEF reduction is determined by the skill, so these stats do not determine whether the support build is complete.
messages.攻击范围随音擎与主词条变化，不是每种武器都应达到同一上限。: ATK ranges vary with W-Engine and main stats. Every weapon is not expected to reach the same upper value.
messages.攻击需要量由特殊技等级决定；来源只列8/10/15/16级，不应插值冒充精确门槛: Required ATK depends on Special Attack level. The source only lists levels 8/10/15/16; interpolations should not be presented as exact thresholds.
messages.明确按初始暴率；临时战斗暴率不能自动填入此公式。: Explicitly uses initial CRIT Rate. Temporary combat CRIT Rate cannot automatically enter this formula.
messages.显示精度可向上取3429；不是3500精确阈值。: Round up to 3,429 for display. The exact threshold is not 3,500.
messages.暴伤160–180%未包括混沌重金属四件增益。: 160–180% CRIT DMG excludes the Chaotic Metal 4-piece bonus.
messages.暴伤随音擎和4号主属性改变。: CRIT DMG varies with W-Engine and slot 4 main stat.
messages.暴击44–66%为战前参考；实战暴击目标90–100%取决于盘和其他条件。: 44–66% CRIT Rate is a pre-combat reference. The 90–100% combat target depends on discs and other conditions.
messages.暴击50–57%限定专武方案；没有专武时不能照搬。: 50–57% CRIT Rate assumes the signature W-Engine and cannot be copied directly without it.
messages.暴击57–72%在耀壳与1影增益之前；其他影画/专武须按实际增益调整。: 57–72% CRIT Rate is before the specified state and M1 bonuses. Adjust for actual bonuses from other Mindscapes or the signature W-Engine.
messages.暴击60–70%不含额外能力30%；搭配6影妮可来源另设场外55%上限。: 60–70% CRIT Rate excludes the Additional Ability’s 30%. With M6 Nicole, the source gives a separate 55% out-of-combat ceiling.
messages.暴击80–100%应结合初始暴击转冲击的机制；未给出额外攻击/暴伤硬性功能门槛。: Evaluate 80–100% CRIT Rate with the initial-CRIT-to-Impact conversion. No additional hard ATK/CRIT DMG utility thresholds are given.
messages.暴击80–90%包含驱动盘战斗增益，不能原样标为场外。: 80–90% CRIT Rate includes combat Drive Disc bonuses and cannot be labeled unchanged as out-of-combat.
messages.暴击90–100%包含角色与盘的战斗效果；能量80%是额外回复百分比。: 90–100% CRIT Rate includes Agent and disc combat effects. The 80% energy value is bonus regen percentage.
messages.暴击90–100%是含盘效果与专武的战斗目标。: 90–100% CRIT Rate is a combat target including disc effects and the signature W-Engine.
messages.暴击90–100%是含盘效果与专武的战斗目标；其他配置需重新扣除实际可触发的增益: 90–100% CRIT Rate is a combat target including disc effects and the signature W-Engine. Other builds must subtract the bonuses they can actually activate.
messages.暴击是击破功能属性，额外能力90%封顶；攻击和暴伤为补充输出，专武会显著影响暴击: CRIT Rate supports stun utility, with the Additional Ability capped at 90%. ATK and CRIT DMG supplement damage; the signature W-Engine substantially changes how easily the CRIT target is reached.
messages.暴击率58–78%未加额外能力和如影相随四件；暴伤160–200%未加核心的战斗: 58–78% CRIT Rate excludes the Additional Ability and the stated 4-piece set. 160–200% CRIT DMG excludes the Core Skill’s combat bonus.
messages.来源22,000–24,000+是培养范围，分享全效果应瞄准24,000初始生命: The source gives 22,000–24,000+ as a build range. Aim for 24,000 initial HP for the full shared effect.
messages.来源80–100%暴击含核心25%，不计其他暴击增益时对应场外55–75%。: The source’s 80–100% CRIT Rate includes 25% from the Core Skill. Excluding other buffs, this corresponds to 55–75% out of combat.
messages.来源副词条顺序明确指向战斗暴击100%；角色的初始暴击转换另按本地技能核对。: The source’s substat priorities explicitly aim for 100% combat CRIT Rate. Initial-CRIT conversion is checked separately against the skill data.
messages.来源战斗80–100减核心25；不含其他暴击增益。: Source combat target of 80–100 minus the Core Skill’s 25; excludes other CRIT bonuses.
messages.来源把攻击标为可选，但本地机制仍由攻击缩放；不把可选文字理解为攻击完全无用。: The source labels ATK optional, but the mechanics still scale with ATK. Optional does not mean useless.
messages.来源括号把65.8+32误写为97.2；正确相加为97.8。保留场外值，战斗值重: The source incorrectly writes 65.8 + 32 as 97.2; the correct sum is 97.8. The out-of-combat value is retained and the combat value recalculated.
messages.来源攻击4000指角色面板门槛；精通370–460+取决于4号主属性和两件套。: The source’s 4,000 ATK is a displayed-stat threshold. 370–460+ Anomaly Proficiency depends on slot 4 and the 2-piece set.
The source explicitly assumes 12% combat CRIT Rate from its 4-piece set and 20% from a 1-star signature W-Engine. The listed 58.6–65.8% is out of combat.
messages.来源是推荐范围，并非为全部00–65组合分别计算。没有注明的影画或音擎条件保持未: The source provides a recommended range, not independent calculations for every 00–65 combination. Unspecified Mindscape and W-Engine conditions remain unknown.
messages.来源暴击75–95为较宽参考，其副词条栏另强调80%；应优先核对核心80%暴击积: The source gives a broad 75–95 CRIT Rate range, while its substat section emphasizes 80%. First check the Core Skill’s 80% buildup threshold, including actual disc and W-Engine effects.
messages.来源毕业行未明确暴击90–100%是否包括专武条件暴击；不得一律标为严格场外目标: The source does not specify whether its 90–100% CRIT Rate target includes conditional signature bonuses. It must not automatically be labeled a strict out-of-combat goal.
messages.来源毕业表生命25,000+与同页副词条27,000初始生命门槛不同；前者为培养: The source’s 25,000+ HP build table differs from its 27,000 initial-HP substat threshold. The former is a build reference; 27,000 is the full-effect target.
messages.来源直接列出的技能属性门槛。: Skill-stat threshold listed directly by the source.
messages.来源称超4000收益不显著，不宜把它解释为绝对禁止继续增加攻击。: The source describes limited gains above 4,000. This does not mean further ATK is strictly prohibited.
messages.来源穿透38–72%是不同装备范围；72%对应核心满级30%分享上限，低端并不等: The source’s 38–72% PEN Ratio spans different equipment. 72% reaches the max Core Skill’s 30% shared-bonus cap; the low end is not already capped.
messages.核心F全队增益上限：40/0.4=100，锋御20/0.2=100；原文未要求初: Core Skill F team-bonus caps: 40 / 0.4 = 100; Armorer 20 / 0.2 = 100. The text does not require initial CRIT Rate.
messages.核心F条件暴击率+25；只有条件覆盖且无其他增益时，55%其他来源即可满足80%: Core Skill F grants 25% conditional CRIT Rate. With that condition active and no other bonuses, 55% from other sources reaches the 80% threshold, or 75% reaches the usual 100%.
messages.核心F的巡空枪势暴率增益生效，其他临时暴率另扣。: Core Skill F’s stance CRIT bonus is active. Subtract other temporary CRIT bonuses separately.
messages.核心F，M2将系数额外提高19个百分点、上限增加400。: Core Skill F. M2 adds 19 percentage points to the coefficient and raises the cap by 400.
messages.核心F，人偶派出。: Core Skill F, with Bangboo deployed.
messages.核心F，匪石之盾。: Core Skill F, with the shield active.
messages.核心F，天使协律。: Core Skill F, with the harmonization effect active.
messages.核心F，展旗传递增益。: Core Skill F, with the flag-transfer buff active.
messages.核心F，毒素及延续效果。: Core Skill F, toxin and continuation effects active.
messages.核心F，狸之愿。: Core Skill F, with the tanuki wish effect active.
messages.核心F，虎啸触发。: Core Skill F, with the tiger-roar effect triggered.
messages.核心F，通窍作用于下一位入场队友。: Core Skill F, with the effect applied to the next teammate entering the field.
messages.核心F：1.2 + 960/5×0.01 = 3.12；同时达到76.8冲击转换: Core Skill F: 1.2 + 960 / 5 × 0.01 = 3.12; also reaches the 76.8 Impact conversion cap.
messages.核心F；全队触发浸染/净化且伤害属性适用，持续50秒。: Core Skill F; the team triggers the specified effects and the damage attribute is eligible, lasting 50s.
messages.核心F；准星聚焦激活。: Core Skill F; targeting effect active.
messages.核心F；第二项只增特定招式失衡值。: Core Skill F; the second effect only increases specific moves’ Daze.
messages.没有文本给出的毕业防御上限。: The text does not provide an endgame DEF cap.
messages.狂热攻击转换上限: ATK conversion cap during the specified state
messages.狂热状态。: The specified heightened state is active.
messages.由来源数值和明确条件进行算术换算。: Arithmetic conversion from the source values and explicit conditions.
messages.目标带冰焰，积累烈霜异常。: The target has Icefire while Frost Anomaly is built up.
messages.精通287–350+不含精通主属性音擎的额外90；使用该类音擎时来源建议在区间两: 287–350+ Anomaly Proficiency excludes the extra 90 from an Anomaly Proficiency W-Engine. The source recommends adding 90 to both ends when using one.
messages.精通380–450+明确为战前参考，绽放伤害有额外精通缩放。: 380–450+ Anomaly Proficiency is explicitly a pre-combat reference. Bloom damage has additional Proficiency scaling.
messages.精通高级属性音擎参考: Reference for an Anomaly Proficiency W-Engine
messages.能量2.88为每秒回复数值，不能和其他页面的回复百分比直接横比。: Energy Regen 2.88 is a per-second value and cannot be directly compared with regen percentages on other pages.
messages.若只用两位小数展示，至少2.87；不在无实现证据时声明内部按0.01向下取整。: If displayed to two decimals, use at least 2.87. Do not claim the game internally floors to 0.01 without implementation evidence.
messages.虎啸暴伤分享上限: CRIT DMG sharing cap for the tiger-roar effect
messages.角色战斗增益另含暴击率；来源70–88%上限应配合12%核心暴击使用。: The Agent has an additional combat CRIT bonus. The source’s 70–88% upper end assumes the Core Skill’s 12% CRIT Rate.
messages.超过100%不再提升这项分享。: Values above 100% do not improve this sharing effect further.
messages.达攻击门槛后，双暴和异常为择一的可选个人输出方向。: After meeting the ATK threshold, choose either CRIT or Anomaly as an optional personal-damage focus.

messages.想在人群中展翅高飞，风向却暂未相合，于是回到青灯书卷。诗意是时机未到时继续积累。: The wish to rise above the crowd meets an unfavorable wind, and the speaker returns to lamplit study. When timing is wrong, keep building your skills.
messages.今天可以先做准备，不必急于立刻兑现期待。: Today can be a day for preparation rather than immediate fulfillment.
messages.勤耕力作、安分度日是这首诗推重的生活方式。它用稳定收成对照一时厚利，赞美持续与踏: Steady cultivation and modest daily life are contrasted with a quick, large profit. The verse favors consistency and practical effort.
messages.照顾长期的游玩节奏，少追一时的热闹。: Protect your long-term enjoyment instead of chasing every brief excitement.
messages.明知理亏却用强词遮掩，终会在镜中显露，原签劝人正视自己。重点是诚实与承担，而不是: Forceful words cannot indefinitely hide a known mistake. The mirror image asks for honesty and responsibility rather than hoping to get away with it.
messages.承认真实的心情，不用替冲动寻找借口。: Acknowledge how you really feel rather than finding excuses for an impulse.
messages.事情纷杂时，既不能只听别人，也不宜在喧闹中仓促决定。原签把冷静思量放在自主张之前: In complicated circumstances, neither blindly following others nor deciding amid noise is wise. Calm consideration comes before taking your own position.
messages.退出讨论片刻，想清楚再按下确认。: Step out of the discussion and think before confirming.
messages.诗借苏秦之口才写施展本领，同时不忘劝修善行。它赞美能力的作用，也提醒有成后仍须修: The eloquence of Su Qin symbolizes using one’s abilities, alongside continued good conduct. Capability matters, but success does not end the need for self-cultivation.
messages.发挥自己的长处，得意时仍留一分谦逊。: Use your strengths and keep some humility when pleased with yourself.
messages.门庭冷清中的祈愿，最终落在延续与照料的意象上。可把原签读作困境中珍惜已有联系、守: A wish made in a quiet household ends in images of continuity and care. Read it as encouragement to preserve ordinary life and existing connections in difficulty.
messages.与关心你的人保持联系，别让等待变成孤单。: Stay in touch with people who care about you. Waiting need not become isolation.
messages.兄弟同得名声与科第，诗中却先叮嘱谦逊、不自夸。共享荣誉与保持平和，是这首签诗的重: Brothers share honors and achievement, yet humility comes first. The poem values shared happiness without boasting.
messages.有了喜讯就一起开心，不拿结果给别人排高低。: Celebrate good news together without using results to rank people.
messages.面对纷扰与威胁，诗里的主人从容出门，不必动用干戈。可读作以镇定化解对立，减少无谓: Amid disturbance and threats, the central figure walks out calmly without resorting to weapons. Composure can reduce unnecessary conflict.
messages.遇到让你烦心的话，先不急着回应。: Do not rush to answer a remark that upsets you.
messages.诗写历经用力与防备，终于归来相会，带着先难后安的结构。它提醒成果并不总在轻松之中: Effort and vigilance lead eventually to a safe reunion. The structure moves from difficulty to ease, acknowledging that worthwhile results are not always effortless.
messages.认真对待准备，也给自己安排结束后的放松。: Take preparation seriously and plan time to relax afterward.
messages.过去失利，不妨换个方向再看；筋力虽衰，仍有可以尝试之处。末句数语是传统隐喻，不是: Past setbacks may call for a different direction. Even with less strength, something may still be possible. The ending’s numbers are traditional imagery, not pull-count hints.
messages.容许自己重新开始，也尊重当下的精力。: Allow yourself a fresh start while respecting your current energy.
messages.志同道合的人相遇，又有善谋者相助，事情在商量中顺畅。此签赞美默契、公议与合作的力: Like-minded people meet and receive thoughtful help. The verse celebrates cooperation, shared judgment, and mutual understanding.
messages.和合拍的朋友同行，分享心愿也分享好心情。: Go with friends who suit you. Share your wish and your good mood.
messages.寒冬里已有门庭喜气，待新春人事往来，诚恳的话才被理解。诗中有耐心等候、以真心相通: Signs of joy appear in winter, and sincere words are understood when spring brings renewed contact. Patience and honest connection shape the poem.
messages.表达真实的期待，不用急着得到每个人认可。: Express your hopes honestly without rushing to gain everyone’s approval.
messages.耕耘可以留在乡邦，不必总往远处求索，原签赞美熟悉之处的安定。近处也有值得珍惜的相: Cultivation can take place at home rather than always seeking far away. Familiar places offer stability and encounters worth appreciating.
messages.去你最熟悉的街区，找一个喜欢已久的位置。: Visit a familiar district and a place you have liked for a long time.
messages.心意初起，自己其实已有答案；原诗让人回到孝悌与和睦。与其反复问卜，不如先调整自己: A wish first arises when you may already know your answer. The verse returns to family care and harmony, favoring changed behavior over repeated divination.
messages.先照顾现实中的关系，再享受游戏里的片刻仪式。: Care for real relationships before enjoying a brief in-game ritual.
messages.南北贸易虽有所得，欲望却未必随之满足，诗末劝知止。它关心的是何时足够，而不是如何: Trade brings gains, but desire may remain unsatisfied. The ending asks when enough is enough, rather than how to keep adding more.
messages.在开始前写下停止的位置，到了便安心结束。: Write down your stopping point before beginning and finish calmly when you reach it.
messages.正常赶路本无妨，若沉迷宴饮与攀附，转眼朋友也可能反目。原签提醒交往有分寸，别被热: An ordinary journey is harmless, but excessive revelry and status-seeking can turn friendships sour. Enjoy company without losing your boundaries.
messages.不因起哄临时加码，按自己的意愿游玩。: Do not spend more because of group excitement. Play according to your own wishes.
messages.雷雨各有其时，原诗借求雨写诚意与等待。诗中时节属于古人的表达，不代表可据此推算游: Thunder and rain have their seasons. The rain-seeking image joins sincerity with patience; traditional seasonal language does not predict game probabilities.
messages.让期待有耐心，不必追着某一刻求证。: Give hope time instead of chasing a particular moment for proof.
messages.檐前喜鹊报信，远行者想归家，又遇叶落霜飞。欢喜中仍带行程与季节的阻隔，提醒珍惜重: A magpie brings news, while a traveler seeking home meets falling leaves and frost. Joy still has distance and seasonal obstacles to cross.
messages.可以把愿望分享给朋友，也照顾好等待中的自己。: Share a wish with friends and care for yourself while waiting.
messages.路途高低不齐，日色渐晚，诗写迟来的机会与长久跋涉。它适合读作量力而行，不必强赶下: An uneven road and fading daylight evoke a late opportunity after a long journey. Read it as permission to work within your energy rather than forcing the next stage.
messages.如果今天已经疲惫，就把余下心愿留到改日。: If you are already tired, leave the rest of your wishes for another day.
messages.旧日盟约如今音信不合，一心盼望也未必如愿，原签写的是落差。它提醒尊重实际回应，别: An old promise and present news no longer agree; wholehearted hope may still be disappointed. Respect the response you actually receive instead of remaining trapped in expectation.
messages.接受今天的结果，喜欢也可以慢慢等待。: Accept today’s result. Something you like can still be waited for gently.
messages.山势高峻而往来不惧，心如明镜，终见一道春光。此签以澄明之心面对险阻，气象由紧转舒: A steep mountain is met with a clear, mirror-like mind, and a line of spring light appears. Tension eases through clarity rather than panic.
messages.先静心，再出发；不让一时紧张替你作决定。: Calm down before setting out. Let a brief moment of nerves pass before deciding.
messages.相逢投契便有亲近之情，得意时也不必比较贫富高下。原签推重平等与相知，而非外在条件: A congenial meeting brings closeness without needing to compare wealth or standing. The poem prizes equality and understanding over appearances.
messages.与朋友各享各的好运，不必互相较量。: Let friends enjoy their own good fortune without turning it into a contest.
messages.法度条文虽多，善恶的选择仍在自己，原签强调行为与责任。可以借它提醒自己守住明确的: However many rules exist, choices and responsibilities still belong to the individual. The verse encourages keeping clear principles.
messages.把自己的界线记清楚，别为一时兴奋改掉它。: Remember your boundaries and do not rewrite them in excitement.
messages.木有根、水有源，遇事应先查明来由，不跟随路边闲话。全诗劝人求实、止争，重在追根而: Trees have roots and water has a source. Seek the reason behind events instead of following roadside gossip; the poem favors facts and restraint.
messages.遇到所谓出金秘诀，先看依据，不急着照做。: Check the evidence behind a supposed S-Rank trick before trying it.
messages.衣食丰足之后更要心中有分寸，原签警惕拥有越多、欲望越重。它把省察与知足放在继续追: Having enough should bring perspective, yet possessions can also grow desire. Reflection and contentment come before further pursuit.
messages.看看已经获得的快乐，今天也可以到此为止。: Notice the enjoyment you have already had. It is fine to stop here today.
messages.原诗直接使用乾亥、坎午等堪舆方位术语，讲的是特定传统语境下的布局。它不是游戏城市: The poem uses traditional geomancy terms such as Qian-Hai and Kan-Wu in a particular historical setting. It is not a guide to in-game city directions or S-Rank rates.
messages.点位可作寻景线索，实际站位请以游戏指引为准。: Use the location as a sightseeing idea; follow the actual game directions for positioning.
messages.原签把突发困局放在古代阴阳堪舆观念中解释，劝人认真看待变化。这里只介绍其传统语境: A sudden difficulty is explained through old yin-yang and geomantic beliefs. This interpretation presents that historical context without using it to explain real-life misfortune.
messages.把注意力放回眼前能安排的事情，不必因签文自责。: Return attention to what you can arrange now. The verse is no reason to blame yourself.
messages.借来的物品应归还，欺瞒终会在明镜前显露，原诗推重诚实守信。它提醒人明白约定，也明: Borrowed things should be returned, and concealment eventually appears in a clear mirror. The poem values honest agreements and personal responsibility.
messages.如实记录结果，不把巧合说成人人适用的方法。: Record outcomes honestly. Do not turn a coincidence into a method claimed to work for everyone.
messages.相逢之人各有所长，宾主欢会之后还可并肩前行。原签赞美礼遇、结交与彼此成全。: People meet with different strengths, share hospitality, and may then travel together. Respect, friendship, and mutual support are the central ideas.
messages.邀请志趣相同的人同行，让仪式多一份温度。: Invite like-minded friends along and add warmth to the ritual.
messages.日常一粥一饭已有着落，持家却仍不容易，诗末珍惜难得清闲。它劝少些妄想与煎熬，照顾: Even with daily meals secure, keeping a household is not effortless. The ending values rare leisure, encouraging less anxious dreaming and care for ordinary life.
messages.安心享受眼前的小快乐，不必时时求更多。: Enjoy small pleasures without always asking for more.
messages.事情头绪纷乱，先看清局面，再守住礼义与本心。原诗含旧时性别措辞，白话只取不偏听闲: When affairs are tangled, first understand the situation and keep your principles. The original uses dated gender language; this interpretation only retains its caution against uncritical gossip.
messages.面对杂乱建议，先核对事实，再作自己的选择。: Check facts amid conflicting advice, then make your own choice.
messages.风雨中的远行本想求得更多，回程却添惆怅，原签写得失之间的落差。它提醒人看看奔忙是: A journey through wind and rain seeks more but returns with disappointment. The poem asks whether all that striving really suits the heart.
messages.如果越追越累，不妨回到最初让你开心的玩法。: If pursuit keeps making you tired, return to the way of playing that first made you happy.
messages.小船载货、积少成多，诗又让人将他人比作自己。它赞美耐心积累与体谅，而不是一时冒进: A small boat’s cargo suggests gains accumulated little by little, while the poem asks you to see others as yourself. Patience and consideration matter more than a sudden rush.
messages.珍惜一点点积攒的心意，也照顾同行者的感受。: Value gradual progress and consider the feelings of companions.
messages.笑语之下可能藏着隔阂，诗以羽毛喻名声与自重。可以读作谨慎辨人、珍惜品行，少卷入暗: Laughter can conceal distance, while feathers symbolize reputation and self-respect. Be thoughtful about people and avoid hidden conflicts.
messages.保持自己的分寸，不因热闹或挑衅改变计划。: Keep your own boundaries despite excitement or provocation.
messages.从前徒劳，入春渐有转机，原签却在得意处补一句莫心高。顺时守己、不因得失失去平常心: Past effort was fruitless, but spring brings a change; the verse still cautions against pride. Keep your balance when circumstances improve.
messages.开心时也按计划结束，把好心情留下来。: End according to your plan when happy and preserve the good mood.
messages.时机未到，且在杯前高歌，后半再以渡江与高城寄托远景。原签让人在等待里暂且安顿，不: Before the right time arrives, the speaker sings, while the later river crossing and high city suggest a distant future. Waiting can include peace rather than pressure.
messages.找个喜欢的风景稍作停留，让今天也有别的乐趣。: Stay for a while at a view you enjoy. Today can have other pleasures too.
messages.别人事务纷繁，自己能安然无事已属难得，何必再添多余烦恼。此签劝珍惜清静，不为求问: While others are busy with complications, an undisturbed day is already valuable. The poem discourages inventing new worries merely to have something to ask.
messages.没有特别想做的事，今天不调频也很好。: If there is nothing you especially want, not doing Signal Search today is fine.
messages.淘沙见金、诗书见功，原签把收获与细致工夫相连。可以读作耐心学习、反复琢磨，而非等: Finding gold in sand and progress in study connect results with careful work. The image favors learning and practice over waiting for something to appear from nothing.
messages.把精力花在真正喜欢的内容上，慢慢积累自己的理解。: Spend your energy on what you truly enjoy and build understanding gradually.
messages.原诗描写歉收与时势艰难，又用一阳来复寄托安定愿望。它属于古人的困境叙事，不能据签: Poor harvests and a difficult age give way to a wish for returning warmth. This is a historical account of hardship, not a basis for predicting actual illness or disaster.
messages.给自己留出余地，心绪不佳时先照顾日常生活。: Leave yourself room. When your mood is low, care for daily life first.
messages.春雨过多、夏日又旱，直到甘霖才使田园充足，诗意在于由失衡到调和。过程未必顺直，耐: Too much spring rain gives way to summer drought before refreshing rain restores the fields. Balance arrives by an uneven path, leaving a place for patience.
messages.不必用一次起落评价全部经历，慢慢来就好。: One rise or fall does not define the whole experience. Take your time.
messages.器物材料看似相同，巧匠仍需手艺，也要等欣赏它的人。原签赞美技艺与合适的相遇，不以: Materials may look alike, but craftsmanship and someone who appreciates it still matter. The verse values skill and a fitting encounter rather than giving up when unnoticed.
messages.坚持真正喜欢的东西，不用急着得到外界认可。: Stay with what you genuinely like. Recognition does not need to arrive immediately.
messages.袖中藏着珍珠却迟迟未被看见，后来才有相助，原诗写怀才与晚遇。它提醒价值不必由一时: A pearl remains hidden in a sleeve until help comes later. The poem suggests that personal value is not determined by a single moment’s circumstances.
messages.别用今天的结果否定自己，心愿可以慢慢实现。: Do not use today’s outcome to judge yourself. Wishes can take time.
messages.原诗以婚姻子息的迟来安慰等待之人，强调耐心与修为。这是传统祝愿，不据此推断现实家: The verse comforts someone waiting for marriage or children through patience and self-cultivation. This is a traditional blessing, not a prediction about real family or fertility outcomes.
messages.容许心愿有自己的节奏，不必拿别人的进度催自己。: Let hopes have their own rhythm instead of using others’ progress to hurry yourself.
messages.心灰之后忽遇转机，诗中仍叮嘱多行好事、守住方寸。它以晚来的际遇劝人别过早定论，也: An unexpected opportunity follows discouragement, with reminders to do good and remain steady. Do not decide too early that everything is over, or lose balance when pleased.
messages.保持善意与耐心，遇到喜悦就好好珍惜。: Keep kindness and patience, and appreciate happiness when it comes.
messages.经营奔波耗费精神，直到枯木再逢春才有转折。原签让困顿之人保留重新开始的想象，不必: Busy work exhausts the speaker until an old tree returns to spring. The verse preserves the possibility of starting again without making its seasonal imagery a deadline.
messages.疲倦时先停下，重新开始可以从一个小愿望做起。: Pause when tired. A small wish can be the start of a new beginning.
messages.淡淡的旧交经得起时间，得势后仍记故人，诗以骏马康庄写相知相助。它赞美长久情谊，而: A quiet old friendship survives time, and success does not erase familiar companions. The poem values enduring mutual support over brief excitement.
messages.和熟悉的朋友分享心愿，也记得问候对方。: Share a wish with familiar friends and remember to ask how they are.
messages.末签以神明自述收束全书，寄托至诚与圆满之愿。这里保留的是传统签谱的结尾，不代表对: The final slip closes the collection in the deity’s voice with a wish for sincerity and fulfillment. This is the traditional ending, not a guarantee of any outcome.
messages.把仪式停在心安之处，带着祝愿回到自己的旅程。: Let the ritual end when you feel at ease, then return to your own journey with good wishes.
messages.维基文库转录，参照《关帝灵签》姑苏钮氏藏板清刊本扫描。: Transcribed from Wikisource, checked against a scan of the Qing-era Guan Di Oracle edition printed from the Niu family’s blocks in Suzhou.
messages.原签诗为传统文献，来自维基文库各签转录，并保留页面修订号。参照扫描的签序与等级已: The traditional verses come from Wikisource transcriptions with revision IDs preserved. Slip order and grades were checked individually against the scan; verse wording was only partially checked, with confirmed differences noted per slip. This is not a fully collated critical edition. The display uses simplified Chinese conversion while retaining some variant characters; Qian in slip 79 is a trigram name. Plain-language interpretations and calming notes are DUKE’s writing, not original scripture. Game locations, birth-based selection, and Signal Search features do not come from the historical book.
messages.白话解签、静心小笺：DUKE整理（非原签断语）。: Plain-language interpretations and calming notes by DUKE (not original oracle judgments).
messages.甲甲至癸癸为原签排列标记，不是按出生年月日计算的干支。: Codes from Jia-Jia to Gui-Gui mark the original slip order. They are not stem-branch combinations calculated from a birth date.
messages.关圣帝君灵签·一百签: One Hundred Oracle Slips of Lord Guan
messages.古签诗为公有领域文献；网页转录来源为维基文库，保留链接与修订号；扫描文件标示 P: The historical poems are in the public domain. The web transcription is from Wikisource, with its link and revision ID retained; the scan is marked Public Domain.
messages.地点依据官方街区介绍与公开游戏图文核对，来源见各点位链接；HoYoLAB 社区作: Locations were checked against official district introductions and publicly available game articles and images; each spot links its sources. Directions use relative landmarks such as shop entrances and statues, with no unverified coordinates or compass bearings. Element associations and suggested positions are DUKE's entertainment features, not official location attributes, and do not change Signal Search odds.

Suggested spots are outside the lighthouse entrance on the port walkway and beside the lower-level sea-god statue; no lighthouse floor, event scene, or combat stage is required.
messages.2.0 开放的卫非地生活街区，在主线第二季第一章「云霞同归处」期间解锁。随便观、: A residential district of the Waifei Peninsula introduced in Version 2.0 and unlocked during Season 2 Chapter 1, Where Clouds Embrace the Dawn. Suibian Temple and Good Goods belong to this district; complete the area's unlock requirements first.
messages.2.1 开放的临海街区，在主线第二季第二章「迟吟的浪涌」期间解锁。这里选用可步行: A coastal district introduced in Version 2.1 and unlocked during Season 2 Chapter 2, The Impending Crash of Waves. This list uses walkable beach landmarks, independent of limited-time events or uncollected chests.
messages.2.1 开放的海滨休闲场景，随「仲夏游梦绮谭」剧情解锁。活动已收录丽都纪事，可继: A seaside leisure area introduced in Version 2.1 and unlocked through Tales of Midsummer Dreams. The event is available in Ridu Chronicles; facilities such as reception and the aquarium still require the relevant story progress.
messages.1.3 开放的空洞事务机构区域，1.4 扩展了总部外部广场。本轮选用已解锁的室外: A HAND area introduced in Version 1.3, with the headquarters' exterior plaza expanded in Version 1.4. This list uses the unlocked outdoor plaza entrance and does not require entry to the Section 6 offices. Accessible areas depend on main-story progress.
messages.罗斯凯利法的城市步行区域，随主线第三季第一章解锁。贝克福德街等内部街道归在同一城: A walkable city area in Roscaelifer, unlocked through Season 3 Chapter 1. Internal streets such as Beckford Street are grouped under the same district; choose locations accessible at your current story progress.
messages.扫描为八卦“乾”字；网页简体转换显示“干”，此处保留专名“乾”。 列出已确认差异: The scan uses qian, the name of the Qian trigram; the simplified web conversion renders it as gan. The trigram name is retained here. Confirmed differences are listed here. Other characters follow the simplified-Chinese web transcription and have not been checked individually against the scan.

messages.Random Play 的店面招牌与入口: Random Play’s storefront sign and entrance
messages.建议站在店外，面向 Random Play 的门和招牌。: Stand outside facing Random Play’s door and sign.
messages.本站娱乐设定：借录像店作为日常归处的意象关联「土」，提醒自己先安顿心情；不是官方: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: the video store as a familiar home represents earth and a settled mind. This is not an official game element.
messages.在游戏内返回六分街的 Random Play 录像店。: Return to Random Play on Sixth Street in the game.
messages.如果落点在店内，从正门走到街上，再转身面对店门。: If you arrive inside, exit through the front door, then turn to face the shop.
messages.汀曼大师的咖啡店与店外价目招牌: Tin Master’s coffee shop and the menu sign outside
messages.建议站在店外价目招牌前，面向招牌与咖啡店。: Stand in front of the outdoor menu sign, facing the sign and café.
messages.本站娱乐设定：用咖啡饮品的流动意象关联「水」，把短暂停留当作放松；不是官方五行属: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: the flow of coffee represents water, with a short pause for relaxation. This is not an official game element.
messages.在六分街的传送列表选择「咖啡店」。: Select the coffee shop from Sixth Street’s travel list.
messages.在落点附近找到店外价目招牌，走近后停下；无需购买咖啡。: Find the outdoor menu sign near the arrival point and stop beside it. No coffee purchase is needed.
messages.建议站在街边的拉面店柜台前，面向乔普师傅一侧。: Stand by the street-side noodle counter, facing General Chop.
messages.本站娱乐设定：借热汤与烹饪意象关联「火」，给今天添一点行动的热情；不是官方五行属: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: hot soup and cooking represent fire and a little enthusiasm for the day. This is not an official game element.
messages.在六分街的传送列表选择「拉面店」。: Select the noodle shop from Sixth Street’s travel list.
messages.靠近乔普师傅所在的柜台，在可交互的位置前停下；无需点餐。: Approach General Chop’s counter and stop before the interaction point. No order is needed.
messages.建议留在电玩店外，面向金手指的入口招牌。: Remain outside the arcade, facing its entrance sign.
messages.本站娱乐设定：借电玩设备和「金手指」店名的意象关联「金」，寓意把注意力放回操作本: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: arcade equipment and the Godfinger name suggest metal, bringing attention back to playing. This is not an official game element.
messages.解锁电玩店后，在六分街的传送列表选择「电玩店」。: After unlocking the arcade, select it from Sixth Street’s travel list.
messages.在金手指入口前停留，保持镜头朝向店面。: Stop in front of Godfinger and keep the camera facing the storefront.
messages.吟游唱针音像店的招牌与店门: Bardic Needle’s sign and front door
messages.建议站在街上，面向音像店门与唱片展示一侧。: Stand in the street facing the Music Store’s door and record display.
messages.本站娱乐设定：用音乐创作不断生长的意象关联「木」，给新的想法留一点空间；不是官方: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: the growth of musical creativity suggests wood and room for new ideas. This is not an official game element or a claim about the building’s material.
messages.解锁音像店后，在六分街的传送列表选择「音像店」。: After unlocking the Music Store, select it from Sixth Street’s travel list.
messages.在落点附近走近店门，停在店外；无需进行驱动盘调律。: Approach the door near the arrival point and remain outside. No Drive Disc tuning is needed.
messages.建议面对报刊亭的报纸陈列与柜台，停在街道这一侧。: Stay on the street side, facing the newspapers and counter.
messages.本站娱乐设定：从纸张与阅读的意象关联「木」，寓意从日常消息获得新灵感；不是官方五: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: paper and reading suggest wood and inspiration from daily news. This is not an official element; positioning does not affect scratch-card or Signal Search results.
messages.在六分街的传送列表选择「报刊亭」。: Select the newsstand from Sixth Street’s travel list.
messages.找到嗷呜的柜台，在亭前停留即可；不要求刮卡或切换时段。: Find Howl’s counter and stop in front. No scratch card or time change is required.
messages.报刊亭附近的花店与门前花卉: The flower shop and display near the newsstand
messages.建议站在花店外，面向花卉陈列和店面。: Stand outside facing the flower display and storefront.
messages.本站娱乐设定：借花草生长的意象关联「木」，为今天留一点耐心；不是官方五行属性。: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: growing flowers suggest wood and patience. This is not an official game element.
messages.在光映广场的传送列表选择「报刊亭」。: Select the newsstand from Lumina Square’s travel list.
messages.沿报刊亭附近的商铺步行，找到门前摆有花卉的朝露花店，在花卉陈列前停下。: Walk past nearby shops, find the flower display outside Dew Gardening Shop, and stop in front.
messages.光映广场咖啡店的二楼露台: The coffee shop’s upper-floor terrace in Lumina Square
messages.建议停在露台护栏内侧，面向江景。: Stay inside the terrace railing and face the river.
messages.本站娱乐设定：以临江观景的意象关联「水」，把远眺当作整理思路的小休息；不是官方五: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: the river view suggests water and a brief pause to organize your thoughts. This is not an official game element.
messages.在光映广场的传送列表选择「咖啡店」。: Select the coffee shop from Lumina Square’s travel list.
messages.找到通向咖啡店二楼露台的楼梯，沿楼梯上行。: Find the stairs to the café’s upper-floor terrace and go up.
messages.抵达露台后走到临江护栏内侧停下。: Stop inside the railing facing the river.
messages.治安局光映分署门前: Outside the Lumina Square PubSec branch
messages.光映广场分署的入口与治安局标识: The branch entrance and PubSec sign
messages.建议站在入口外侧，面向治安局门口标识。: Stand outside the entrance facing the PubSec sign.
messages.本站娱乐设定：用秩序与专注的意象关联「金」，提醒自己按计划行动；不是官方五行属性: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: order and concentration suggest metal and following a plan. This is not an official game element.
messages.在光映广场的传送列表选择「喵吉长官」。: Select Officer Mewmew from Lumina Square’s travel list.
messages.找到对面的治安局入口，走到门前标识附近停下；无需进入办公区域。: Find the PubSec entrance opposite and stop near its sign. You do not need to enter the offices.
messages.广场雕像前: In front of the plaza statue
messages.喵吉长官附近的大型沉思姿态雕像: The large contemplative statue near Officer Mewmew
messages.建议在雕像基座外的步行区域停下，面向雕像。: Stand on the walkway outside the statue’s base, facing it.
messages.本站娱乐设定：借雕像稳稳驻立的意象关联「土」，给自己片刻沉静；不是官方五行属性，: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: the firmly standing statue represents earth and a moment of calm. This is not an official game element and requires no ghost or limited-time quest trigger.
messages.在芭莱大厦前的传送列表选择「喵吉长官」。: Select Officer Mewmew from Ballet Twins Road’s travel list.
messages.转动镜头找到附近的大型雕像，走近基座外侧的平地。: Turn the camera to find the large nearby statue, then approach the flat area outside its base.
messages.雕像广场旁连接地铁通道的入口: The metro passage entrance beside the statue plaza
messages.建议站在下沉广场这一侧，面向地铁通道入口。: Stand on the plaza side facing the metro passage entrance.
messages.本站娱乐设定：借轨道交通与出发的意象关联「金」，寓意把想法化成下一步；不是官方五: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: rail travel and departure suggest metal and a next step. This is not an official game element; no train ride is needed.
messages.在芭莱大厦前选择「喵吉长官」，来到雕像所在的广场。: Select Officer Mewmew at Ballet Twins Road to reach the statue plaza.
messages.找到广场旁与地铁通道相连的入口，停在入口外侧即可。: Find the nearby entrance connected to the metro passage and stop outside.
messages.广场步道地面层的长椅: A bench on the ground-level plaza walkway
messages.建议面对步道上的长椅，在椅旁的通行区域停下。: Face the bench and stop beside it on the walkway.
messages.本站娱乐设定：把一起坐下聊天的温暖意象关联「火」，提醒自己适时休息再出发；不是官: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: the warmth of sitting together and talking represents fire and taking a rest before moving on. This is not an official element or an assessment of the lighting or bench material.
messages.在芭莱大厦前的传送列表选择「广场步道」。: Select the plaza walkway from Ballet Twins Road’s travel list.
messages.留在地面步道层，沿步道寻找长椅；这条短路线不下地铁楼梯。: Remain at ground level and look along the walkway for a bench. This route does not descend the metro stairs.
messages.高空作业设施下方的叉车旁: Beside the forklift under the work platform
messages.喵吉长官附近、高空作业设施下方的叉车: The forklift below the elevated work facility near Officer Mewmew
messages.建议站在叉车旁的地面通道上，面向车身和作业设施。: Stand on the ground-level path beside the forklift, facing the vehicle and work facility.
messages.本站娱乐设定：用叉车与施工器械的金属意象关联「金」，提醒自己整理工具、稳妥行动；: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: metal machinery and the forklift suggest metal, preparing tools and acting steadily. This is not an official game element.
messages.解锁黑雁工地旧址后，使用街区导航前往「喵吉长官」附近。: After unlocking Brant Street Construction Site, travel near Officer Mewmew.
messages.转动镜头寻找高空作业设施下方的叉车，沿地面通道走到车旁即可；无需寻找或开启小卡格: Turn the camera to find the forklift under the elevated work facility and approach along the ground path. No Mini Cargo Truck needs to be found or opened.
messages.仓储区公示栏前: In front of the storage-area noticeboard
messages.仓储区挖掘机附近的公示栏: The noticeboard near the excavator in the storage area
messages.建议停在公示栏前的地面空处，面向栏面。: Stand on the clear ground in front, facing the noticeboard.
messages.本站娱乐设定：借工地建设与地面驻足的意象关联「土」，寓意先看清安排再出发；不是官: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: construction and standing on firm ground suggest earth, checking the plan before setting out. This is not an official game element.
messages.在黑雁工地旧址的街区导航中选择「仓储区」。: Select the storage area in Brant Street Construction Site’s navigation.
messages.在落点附近转动镜头找到挖掘机一带，沿地面通道走近公示栏；在栏外停下，不需要收集旁: Look for the excavator near the arrival point, then follow the ground path to the noticeboard. Remain outside it; collecting a nearby Mini Cargo Truck is not required.
messages.卡斯珀所在的哨站后勤商店位置: Casper’s Logistics Shop location at the outpost
messages.建议留在前哨区域的步行地面，面向后勤商店的接待位置。: Stay in the walkable outpost area facing the shop’s reception point.
messages.本站娱乐设定：把常驻补给据点的安顿与储备意象关联「土」，提醒自己从容准备；不是官: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: a stable supply base suggests earth, supplies, and calm preparation. This is not an official game element.
messages.哨站开放后，选择「斯科特哨站—后勤商店」；也可先到「前哨区域」再找到卡斯珀。: After unlocking Scott Outpost, select its Logistics Shop. You can also arrive at the outpost area and find Casper.
messages.在接待位置前停下即可；若传送后自动打开商店，关闭商店界面返回场景。无需兑换物资或: Stop before reception. If traveling opens the shop automatically, close it to return to the scene. No purchases or Hollow Zero entry are required.
messages.芝托邦餐厅外加油机旁: Beside the fuel pump outside Cheesetopia
messages.芝托邦餐厅柜台外的绿色加油机: The green fuel pump outside Cheesetopia’s counter
messages.建议站在餐厅外的空地，面向加油机与餐厅柜台。: Stand in the open area outside the restaurant, facing the pump and counter.
messages.本站娱乐设定：借燃料与重新出发的意象关联「火」，为今天添一点行动的热情；不是官方: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: fuel and a fresh departure represent fire and enthusiasm. This is not an official game element.
messages.在已开放的野火镇中，使用街区导航前往「芝托邦餐厅」。: In unlocked Blazewood, navigate to Cheesetopia.
messages.在餐厅柜台外找到绿色加油机，走到机身前的空地停下；不需要邀请代理人同行。: Find the green pump outside the counter and stop in the clear space in front. No Agent invitation is required.
messages.餐厅对面的仙人掌旁: Beside the cactus opposite the restaurant
messages.建议站在仙人掌旁的可行走地面，面向植株；保持在道路一侧即可。: Remain on the walkable roadside facing the cactus.
messages.本站娱乐设定：用仙人掌在外环生长的植物意象关联「木」，寓意保持耐心与生机；不是官: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: a cactus growing in the Outer Ring represents wood, patience, and vitality. This is not an official game element.
messages.从餐厅前观察对面的仙人掌，沿可行走地面靠近后停下；无需等待老德米尔等任务人物出现: Look across from the restaurant for the cactus and approach on walkable ground. No quest character needs to appear.
messages.港口步道尽头一带的炬光灯塔一楼入口: The lighthouse’s ground-floor entrance near the end of the port walkway
messages.建议站在灯塔一楼入口外，面向塔门与灯塔。: Stand outside the ground-floor entrance, facing the door and lighthouse.
messages.本站娱乐设定：用灯塔指路的光亮意象关联「火」，寓意先找到自己的方向；不是官方五行: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: a lighthouse’s guiding light represents fire and finding your direction. This is not an official game element.
messages.厄匹斯港开放后，使用街区导航前往「港口步道」。: After unlocking Port Elpis, navigate to the port walkway.
messages.沿步道朝灯塔走，到一楼入口外停下即可；不进入灯塔，不选择楼层，也无需开启相关活动: Follow the walkway toward the lighthouse and stop outside its ground-floor entrance. Do not enter or select a floor; no related event is required.
messages.海神雕像前: In front of the sea-god statue
messages.港口下层、喵吉长官附近的海神雕像: The lower-port statue near Officer Mewmew
messages.建议站在雕像基座外的平地，面向海神雕像。: Stand on flat ground outside the base, facing the statue.
messages.本站娱乐设定：以港口和海神雕像的海洋意象关联「水」，把短暂停留当作平复心情；不是: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: the port and sea statue represent water and a short pause to settle your mood. This is not an official game element.
messages.推进厄匹斯港相关主线、开放对应导航后，前往「喵吉长官」附近。: Progress the Port Elpis story until the relevant navigation opens, then travel near Officer Mewmew.
messages.在周围找到海神雕像，走到基座前的平地停下即可；不需要邀请浅羽悠真，也无需触发拍照: Find the sea-god statue and stop before its base. No Harumasa invitation, photo task, or commemorative-coin task is required.
messages.随便观正门雕塑前: In front of the Suibian Temple gate sculpture
messages.随便观正门外的固定雕塑: The permanent sculpture outside Suibian Temple’s main gate
messages.建议站在观外雕塑前，转身面向雕塑。: Stand outside the temple and turn to face the sculpture.
messages.本站娱乐设定：用观前雕塑的安定意象关联「土」，作为抽卡前整理心情的停留点；不是官: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: the sculpture’s steadiness represents earth and a place to settle your thoughts before Signal Search. This is not an official game element.
messages.在澄辉坪选择「随便观外庭」传送，进入观外公共步行区域。: Select Suibian Temple’s outer courtyard in Failume Heights and enter the public walkway outside.
messages.找到正门外的雕塑，走近后面向雕塑停下。: Find the sculpture outside the main gate, approach, and face it.
messages.建议站在好物铺店外，面向店面和柜台。: Stand outside facing the shopfront and counter.
messages.本站娱乐设定：借材料交换与店铺交易的意象关联「金」，提醒自己先定好抽卡预算；不是: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: trading and exchanging materials represent metal, reminding you to set a pull budget. This is not an official game element.
messages.在澄辉坪的传送列表选择「好物铺」。: Select the shop from Failume Heights’ travel list.
messages.沿落点附近的步行区走近好物铺，在店面前停下并面向柜台。: Follow the walkable area near the arrival point toward the shop and stop facing the counter.
messages.街区下层通向海面的沙滩: The lower district’s beach facing the sea
messages.建议站在可步行的沙滩边缘，面向海面。: Stay on the walkable beach edge, facing the sea.
messages.本站娱乐设定：用海面与潮汐的流动意象关联「水」，借看海给自己留一段安静时间；不是: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: the sea and flowing tides represent water, offering a quiet moment by the shore. This is not an official game element.
messages.进入已解锁的泅珑围，沿街区楼梯走向下层临海沙滩。: Enter unlocked Sailume Bay and follow the district stairs down toward the beach.
messages.走到沙滩与海岸衔接处，保持在可步行范围内，转向海面停下。: Approach where the beach meets the shore, remain within the walkable area, and turn to face the sea.
messages.建议站在接待台访客一侧，面向柜台。: Stand on the visitor side facing the desk.
messages.本站娱乐设定：借度假村迎接访客的热闹意象关联「火」，把停留当作出发前的小仪式；不: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: a lively welcome represents fire and a small ritual before setting out. This is not an official game element.
messages.先解锁绮梦度假村，再在该区域的传送列表选择「度假村接待处」。: Unlock Fantasy Resort, then select resort reception in its travel list.
messages.在落点附近找到接待台，走到访客一侧并面对柜台停下。: Find the desk near the arrival point and stop on the visitor side facing it.
messages.水色幻影水族馆鱼缸前: In front of an Aqua Mirage Aquarium tank
messages.「水色幻影」水族馆内的展示鱼缸: A display tank inside Aqua Mirage Aquarium
messages.建议站在展示鱼缸前，面向缸内水景。: Stand before the display tank facing the underwater scene.
messages.本站娱乐设定：用水族馆水景的舒缓意象关联「水」，让注意力从抽卡结果回到片刻观赏；: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: the calming aquarium scene represents water, shifting attention from pulls to a moment of appreciation. This is not an official game element.
messages.推进「仲夏游梦绮谭」解锁水族馆后，在绮梦度假村前往「水色幻影」水族馆。: Progress the summer-resort story to unlock the aquarium, then visit Aqua Mirage Aquarium in Fantasy Resort.
messages.进入后找到展示鱼缸，走近缸前并面向水景停下；无需兑换装饰。: Find a display tank inside and stop facing it. No decoration exchange is required.
messages.总部广场入口告示墙: Notice wall at the headquarters plaza entrance
messages.广场入口商务车附近、带禁止拍照标志的外墙: The outside wall with a no-photography sign near a van
messages.建议站在室外步行区，面向带告示标志的外墙。: Stay on the outdoor walkway and face the wall with the sign.
messages.本站娱乐设定：借机构广场与告示的秩序意象关联「金」，提醒自己先定好本次抽数；不是: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: institutional order and notices represent metal, reminding you to choose a pull limit. This is not an official game element.
messages.在已解锁的 HAND 总部选择「HAND广场入口」传送。: At unlocked HAND Headquarters, travel to the plaza entrance.
messages.找到落点附近商务车旁的告示外墙，沿步行区走近并面向标志停下。: Find the notice wall beside the van near the arrival point, approach on the walkway, and face the sign.
messages.贝克福德街的片刻闲（Cuppa Moment）店面: Cuppa Moment’s storefront on Beckford Street
messages.建议站在店外可通行处，面向片刻闲的店面招牌。: Stand in the walkable area outside facing the shop sign.
messages.本站娱乐设定：借茶饮的流动意象关联「水」，把片刻停留当作舒缓心情的仪式；不是官方: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: flowing tea represents water and a quiet moment to ease your mood. This is not an official game element.
messages.解锁布亚斯特城区后，前往贝克福德街，寻找片刻闲茶店。: After unlocking Banbastrum, go to Beckford Street and find Cuppa Moment.
messages.以 Cuppa Moment 招牌辨认店面，在门前停留即可；无需点单。: Identify it by the Cuppa Moment sign and stop at the entrance. No order is required.
messages.布连邦雕像前: In front of the Interboo statue
messages.建议在雕像旁可站立的地面停下，将镜头转向雕像。: Stand on accessible ground beside the statue and turn the camera toward it.
messages.本站娱乐设定：借雕像安稳矗立的意象关联「土」，寓意先定心再启程；不是官方五行属性: DUKE’s for-fun symbolism: the firmly standing statue represents earth and settling the mind before a journey. This is not an official game element.
messages.在已解锁的布亚斯特城区中前往布连邦雕像附近。: In unlocked Banbastrum, head toward the statue.
messages.走到雕像前方的步行区域，以雕像作为朝向参照；无需提交物品。: Stop on the walkway in front and use the statue as your facing reference. No item submission is required.
messages.四件暴击增益需初始防御达到1000/1800。；穿透二件套收益需结合队伍；多个二: The 4-piece CRIT bonus requires 1,000/1,800 initial DEF. The PEN 2-piece set’s value depends on your team; choose only one 2-piece option.
messages.借古签寄一份心愿，在熟悉的街巷，等一段新的回响。: Leave a wish with an old verse and discover a new moment in familiar streets.
messages.一份生辰，一日一签。: One birth date. One fortune each day.
messages.这是农历闰月: This is a lunar leap month
messages.按东八区（UTC+8）民用时间填写。不知道时辰也可求签，时柱会留空。: Enter civil time in UTC+8. You can still draw a fortune without a known birth time; the hour pillar will remain blank.
messages.无需出生资料。同一当地日期，对应同一支通用签；日期跟随设备时区。: No birth details needed. Everyone gets the same general fortune for the same local date, using your device’s time zone.
messages.请按游戏内已解锁情况勾选。下列为本站已收录街区，后续还会继续补充。: Select the districts you have unlocked in the game. More supported districts may be added later.
messages.地点从勾选街区中推荐，切换街区不会换签。: Locations are chosen from your selected districts. Changing districts does not change your fortune.
messages.正在载入签谱与排盘工具…: Loading fortune slips and calendar tools…
messages.出生资料仅在本机内存中计算，刷新即清除。: Birth details are processed only in your browser’s memory and cleared on refresh.
messages.心有所期，静候一签: Make a wish and draw a slip
messages.填下生辰，或求一支今日通用签。: Enter your birth details or draw today’s general fortune.

messages.按已勾选街区推荐地标，用地标确定站位与朝向。当前为文字指引，非实测导航；地标元素: Landmarks are recommended within selected districts, with suggested positions and directions. These are written directions, not tested navigation. Landmark elements are DUKE’s own choices.

messages.八字排盘、每日选签与游戏点位对应是不同部分。选签及地点匹配采用本站公开的娱乐规则: The birth chart, daily slip selection, and game-location matching are separate systems. Selection and matching use DUKE’s published rules for entertainment, not professional fortune-telling.
messages.留住一纸签文，回看当时心愿。: Keep a slip to revisit a wish.
messages.求签后点击“收入签簿”。仅保存日期、签号与地点，不保存生辰。: After drawing, select “Save to journal.” Only the date, slip number, and locations are saved, not birth details.
messages.民俗娱乐 · 调频概率以游戏规则为准。: Folklore entertainment · Signal Search rates follow the game’s rules.

messages.地点更新失败，请重新求签。: Could not update locations. Draw your fortune again.
