messages.年柱按立春交接时刻划分，月柱按节令交接时刻划分。: The year pillar changes at the exact Start of Spring solar term; month pillars change at their corresponding solar terms.
messages.采用晚子时仍属当日日柱的口径（sect=2）：23:00 不换日柱，00:00: Uses the sect=2 convention: the day pillar changes at 00:00, not 23:00. From 23:00 to 23:59, the hour stem is calculated from the next day’s stem.
messages.按填写的东八区钟表时间计算，不换算真太阳时，也不自动还原历史夏令时。: Uses the entered UTC+8 clock time without conversion to apparent solar time or automatic historical daylight-saving correction.
messages.求签日期应为 YYYY-MM-DD。: The fortune date must use YYYY-MM-DD.
messages.求签日期无效或超出支持范围。: The fortune date is invalid or outside the supported range.
messages.请填写出生日期，或选择今日通用签。: Enter your birth date or choose today’s general fortune.
messages.请选择公历或农历。: Choose the Gregorian or Chinese lunar calendar.
messages.出生年份支持 1900 年至今。: Supported birth years run from 1900 to the present.
messages.月份应为 1 至 12。: The month must be from 1 to 12.
messages.小时应为 0 至 23，不知道时辰请选择未知。: The hour must be 0–23. Select unknown if you do not know your birth time.
messages.请明确是否为农历闰月。: Specify whether this is a lunar leap month.
messages.公历没有闰月选项，请取消勾选或改选农历。: The Gregorian calendar has no leap-month option. Uncheck it or choose the lunar calendar.
messages.所选公历月份没有这一天，请核对出生日期。: This day does not exist in the selected Gregorian month. Check your birth date.
messages.该农历年份没有所选闰月，请核对年份和闰月选项。: The selected lunar year does not have this leap month. Check the year and leap-month setting.
messages.所选农历月份没有这一天，请核对出生日期。: This day does not exist in the selected lunar month. Check your birth date.
messages.出生日期应在公历 1900 年 1 月 1 日至今天之间。: The birth date must be between January 1, 1900 and today in the Gregorian calendar.
messages.无法换算该日期，请核对历法、日期和闰月选项。: Could not convert the date. Check the calendar, date, and leap-month setting.
messages.出生时辰未知：时柱留空，属于简化排盘。: Birth time unknown: the hour pillar is blank, giving a simplified chart.
messages.出生当天有节令交接，未知时辰无法确定对应年柱或月柱，已列出可能值。: A solar-term transition occurred on the birth date. Without a birth time, the year or month pillar is uncertain; possible values are listed.
messages.传统签谱只提供原签文。八字、每日日期与游戏地点之间没有签谱自带的对应关系，以下选: The traditional collection provides only the original verses. It has no built-in link between birth charts, dates, and game locations. The selection and matching rules below are DUKE’s own entertainment feature.
messages.将换算后的出生日期、填写的时间（或未知标记）和设备当地日期，用固定算法映射到签库: A fixed algorithm maps the converted birth date, entered time (or unknown marker), and device-local date to a slip. The date changes at local midnight. Identical details on the same date give the same slip; changing unlocked districts only changes location choices. General fortunes use the local date alone.
messages.场景五行为本站按环境意象设置：与出生日干五行相同加 2 分，与求签当天日干五行相: DUKE assigns a five-element symbol to each scene: matching the birth-day stem’s element adds 2 points; matching today’s element adds 1. Ties use a fixed daily order. General fortunes only compare today’s element. Scores only rank locations; they are not luck or S-Rank probabilities.
messages.不以五行数量判断喜用神，不评判命格吉凶，不把匹配分当作真实运势。民俗娱乐，调频概: No favorable element or destiny judgment is inferred from element counts, and match scores are not real fortunes. This is folklore entertainment; Signal Search rates follow the game’s rules.
messages.排盘和选签在本机完成，出生资料不写入网址或默认保存。签簿和分享图应只包含签号、日: Charts and slip selection run in your browser. Birth details are not written to the URL or saved by default. Journal entries and shared images contain only slip numbers, dates, and game locations.
messages.签谱为空，请先加载签文。: The collection is empty. Load the slips first.
messages.已解锁场景应为列表。: Unlocked locations must be provided as a list.
messages.按本机出生资料与设备当地日期取签；地点按五行意象匹配分排列，属于本站游戏趣味演绎: The slip uses birth details in this browser and your device’s local date. Locations are ranked by element symbolism for this entertainment feature.
messages.今日通用签只使用设备当地日期；地点按当天日干与场景意象匹配，不代表个人八字。: The general fortune only uses your device’s local date. Locations match today’s stem to scene symbolism, not a personal birth chart.

messages.尚未计入核心被动的暴击率加成；是否应写回局外初始面板待实机核对。: The Core Passive's CRIT Rate bonus is not yet included. Whether it belongs in the initial out-of-combat stats still needs in-game verification.

messages.尚未计入初始暴击率转冲击力；原文含进场表述，局外适用性待核对。: The conversion from initial CRIT Rate to Impact is not yet included. The description specifies entering combat, so its out-of-combat application needs verification.
messages.尚未计入核心被动的异常精通加成；是否写回局外初始面板待实机核对。: The Core Passive's Anomaly Proficiency bonus is not yet included. Whether it belongs in the initial out-of-combat stats still needs in-game verification.
messages.尚未计入核心精通加成及初始掌控转冲击力；局外面板适用性待核对。: The Core Passive's Anomaly Proficiency bonus and initial Anomaly Mastery-to-Impact conversion are not yet included. Their out-of-combat application needs verification.
messages.尚未计入初始异常掌控转异常精通；其局外初始面板适用性待实机核对。: The conversion from initial Anomaly Mastery to Anomaly Proficiency is not yet included. Its application to the initial out-of-combat stats still needs in-game verification.
messages.尚未计入初始能量自动回复转异常掌控；局外面板适用性待实机核对。: The conversion from initial Energy Regen to Anomaly Mastery is not yet included. Its out-of-combat application still needs in-game verification.
messages.尚未计入初始暴击率转暴伤及贯穿力转攻击；局外面板适用性待核对。: The conversions from initial CRIT Rate to CRIT DMG and from Sheer Force to ATK are not yet included. Their out-of-combat application needs verification.
messages.尚未计入初始能量自动回复转攻击及冲击力；局外适用性待实机核对。: The conversions from initial Energy Regen to ATK and Impact are not yet included. Their out-of-combat application still needs in-game verification.
messages.毕业是作者给出的培养参考范围，不是官方评级、伤害验算或00–65各组合的独立最优: Endgame ranges are the author's build references, not official grades, damage validations, or separately optimized solutions for every M0R0–M6R5 configuration.
messages.min/max保留推荐范围；upperOpen表示来源上端带+，max不是硬性封: min/max preserve the recommended range. upperOpen means the source adds a “+” to its upper end; max is not a hard cap. An omitted maximum does not mean unlimited investment is beneficial.
messages.panelContext=initial-reference-unqualifi: panelContext=initial-reference-unqualified means the source does not define the context of each stat. Treat it as a reference; do not claim that every combat buff is excluded.
messages.in-combat/initial/signature-conditioned保: in-combat/initial/signature-conditioned preserve the stated conditions. Check sourceVariants and notes before adjusting the figures for the actual equipment.
messages.每源日期为Last updated页面标注，不等于每条数值刚重新测算。: Source dates use the page's “Last updated” label; they do not mean that every number was recalculated on that date.
messages.HP和DEF若非角色缩放属性，通常只是来源的生存参考，不要冒充优先刷取目标。: When an Agent does not scale with HP or DEF, these values are generally survivability references, not priority farming targets.
messages.需要全影画/专武配置时，结合本地技能修正可获得的属性与门槛，不要把作者区间随影画: For other Mindscape and signature W-Engine configurations, use the stored skill data to adjust available stats and thresholds. Do not scale the author's ranges linearly with Mindscape or W-Engine stars.
messages.保持作者假定的云岿四件战斗暴击12%: Keep the author's assumed 12% in-combat CRIT Rate from the 4-piece Yunkui Tales effect.
messages.海妖摇篮生命降低至最大值50%的暴击效果已触发: The CRIT effect of Kraken's Cradle is active after HP falls to 50% of maximum HP.
messages.其他影画、队伍和战斗暴击增益保持相同: Keep all other Mindscape, squad, and in-combat CRIT bonuses unchanged.
messages.此为维持相同战斗目标的条件换算，不是作者对每阶重新测算的毕业线: This conditional conversion preserves the same combat target; it is not an endgame benchmark recalculated by the author for each W-Engine star level.
messages.每套为4件套加一组2件套；多个2件选项只选其中一组。主属性按技能机制给出可选方向: Each build uses a 4-piece set plus one 2-piece set; choose only one of the listed 2-piece options. Main stats are alternatives based on the Agent's mechanics, not an optimal-build ranking. Unless stated otherwise, thresholds use the maxed Core Skill description; the actual values depend on skill level and combat conditions.
messages.以客户端技能、属性库、套装原文核验可行性，再按角色缩放整理；EquipmentA: Builds are checked against client skill text, stat data, and set descriptions, then organized by the Agent's scaling. EquipmentAutoTemplateTb supplies candidate sets only; undecoded fields are not treated as official 4+2 combinations or slot assignments.

messages.本列表只描述可刷出的副词条；冲击力、能量自动回复、异常掌控、穿透率请从主属性、套: This list only covers obtainable substats. Check main stats, sets, or W-Engines for Impact, Energy Regen, Anomaly Mastery, and PEN Ratio.

messages.攻击力 4000：4000 初始攻击是三异常队伍且额外能力生效时，40%分享达到: ATK 4,000: with three Anomaly Agents and the Additional Ability active, 4,000 initial ATK lets the 40% sharing effect reach its 1,600 cap. This benchmark applies to that specific composition; personal builds list it separately as a squad reference without requiring that team.

messages.穿透对这一路已无视防御的贯穿伤害不提供相同收益；不扩展为所有来源伤害均无用。: PEN does not provide the same benefit to this Sheer DMG, which already ignores DEF. This does not mean PEN is useless for every source of damage.
messages.M4；发动强化特殊技后每层7%，两层各15秒，按当前层数而非默认满层。: M4: after an EX Special Attack, each stack grants 7% for 15s, up to 2 stacks. Use the actual stack count; do not assume maximum stacks.
messages.M6；妮可能量场对该敌人造成伤害后，每层1.5%最多10层，各12秒，所有单位仅: M6: after Nicole's energy field damages that enemy, each stack grants 1.5%, up to 10 stacks, lasting 12s each. Applies to all units only against that target.
messages.以最大生命值而非初始生命值转换；对应属性贯穿伤害忽略防御。: The conversion uses Max HP, rather than initial HP. The corresponding Attribute's Sheer DMG ignores DEF.
messages.生命降低至最大值50%触发，须确认低血窗口。: Triggers when HP falls to 50% of Max HP. Confirm that the low-HP window is active.
messages.M6；发动超强力盾击或支援之锋后15秒。两招本身的必暴另算。: M6: lasts 15s after Overpowered Shield Bash or Aiding Blade. Those two moves' guaranteed CRITs are handled separately.
messages.M6；仅超强力盾击与支援之锋。不能将其他攻击的暴击需求也清零。: M6: only Overpowered Shield Bash and Aiding Blade. Other attacks still need their own CRIT Rate.
messages.超强力盾击与支援之锋: Overpowered Shield Bash and Aiding Blade
messages.M4；仅强化特殊技，离目标越近越高，32%是距离增益上限而非任意距离固定值。: M4: only EX Special Attacks. The bonus grows at closer range; 32% is the maximum distance-based bonus, not a fixed value at every range.
messages.M2进入战场获得；不要假定展柜初始面板已经计入。: Granted upon entering battle at M2. Do not assume it is already included in the Showcase's initial stats.
messages.M4发动连携技或终结技，全队12秒。: M4: using a Chain Attack or Ultimate grants the team bonus for 12s.
messages.额外能力已激活，并持有本核心守卫的护盾；其他来源护盾不自动满足。: Requires the Additional Ability to be active and a shield from Ben's Core Passive: Guardian. Shields from other sources do not automatically qualify.
messages.发动终结技后鬼面状态15秒。: The Masked state lasts 15s after using the Ultimate.
messages.达标后补输出: Add damage after meeting the requirements
messages.达标后补小猪输出: Add Guard Boar damage after meeting the requirements
messages.M1消耗急冻充能后每点2%，最多6层，各15秒。: M1: each Flash Freeze Charge consumed grants 2%, up to 6 stacks lasting 15s each.
messages.普通攻击命中后8秒。: Lasts 8s after a Basic Attack hits.
messages.冲刺攻击造成冰伤后15秒。: Lasts 15s after a Dash Attack deals Ice DMG.
messages.核心F；仅冲刺攻击飞弦·斩。: Core F: applies only to Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.
messages.适配专武技能的直接暴击加成，显示层需核。: The signature W-Engine provides a direct CRIT Rate bonus. Its treatment in displayed stats still needs verification.
messages.队伍造成属性异常或失衡后15秒。: Lasts 15s after the team inflicts an Attribute Anomaly or Stun.
messages.装备时流贤者R1～R5；紊乱伤害加成门槛为效果时375精通。其命中异常目标的75: With Timeweaver at R1–R5, the Disorder DMG bonus requires 375 Anomaly Proficiency while the effect is active. Its temporary 75/85/95/105/115 Anomaly Proficiency after hitting an Anomaly-afflicted enemy counts only during actual uptime.
messages.额外能力已激活；强化特殊技、连携技或终结技后10秒。: Requires the Additional Ability to be active. Lasts 10s after an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate.
messages.M1醉花月云转时电压已满，命中后仅对该目标15秒。: M1: Flash Connect Voltage must be full when using Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms. After it hits, the effect lasts 15s against that target only.
messages.M6狂热状态普通暴击；不加入啮咬强击的独立暴率公式。: M6: applies to normal CRITs in the Passion state. Do not add it to the separate CRIT Rate formula for Assault against Gnawed enemies.
messages.M1狂热状态；每点异常精通提高0.1%自身伤害，最多30%，不等于总精通上限。: M1: in the Passion state, each point of Anomaly Proficiency increases own DMG by 0.1%, up to 30%. This is not a cap on total Anomaly Proficiency.
messages.M6；仅普通攻击雷霆击-感电的终结一击。不能将其他攻击的暴击需求也清零。: M6: only the finishing strike of Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified. Other attacks still need their own CRIT Rate.
messages.普通攻击雷霆击-感电的终结一击: The finishing strike of Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified
messages.M1盾量和上限同时提高30%；核心F输入3750保持。: M1 increases both the shield value and its cap by 30%. The Core F input threshold remains 3,750.
messages.核心F暗渊回响状态6秒；需连携技命中或自身使敌人失衡。: Core F: Dark Abyss Reverb lasts 6s. Requires a Chain Attack hit or the Agent personally Stunning the enemy.
messages.M1暗渊回响中触发决算时；只增当前决算招式。: M1: applies when Totalize triggers during Dark Abyss Reverb. Only boosts the current move that triggers Totalize.
messages.核心F；其他击破队友1名/2名分别提供300/900攻击。未知配队不默认0。: Core F: 1/2 other Stun teammates grant 300/900 ATK respectively. An unspecified team is not automatically treated as zero teammates.
messages.核心F文字直接提供；显示层仍需跟估算实现核对。: Provided directly by the Core F text. Its displayed value still needs to be checked against the estimation implementation.
messages.M6；咏叹华彩的震音/音簇，及精准支援自动追加的指定随想曲第三段；不是所有招式。: M6: applies to Tremolo and Tone Clusters in Idyllic Cadenza, and the specified automatic third hit of Capriccio following a Precise Assist. Does not apply to every move.
messages.核心F牵缠禁制状态，退出后保留10秒。: Core F: applies during Binding Seal and remains for 10s after leaving the state.
messages.M4；仅裙裾浮游·悬落和落羽生花。不能将其他攻击的暴击需求也清零。: M4: only Fluttering Frock - Suspension and Featherbloom. Other attacks still need their own CRIT Rate.
messages.M1对困迹敌人造成伤害时；非任意目标和初始面板。: M1: applies when damaging enemies affected by Binding Trap. Does not apply against every target or to initial stats.
messages.队伍满足额外能力条件。: The team must meet the Additional Ability's activation conditions.
messages.M2文字直接提供；潜能觉醒后续招式加成独立判断。: Provided directly by the M2 text. Any further move bonuses from Potential Awakening are checked separately.
messages.M6；仅决胜状态额外精通倍率攻击。不能将其他攻击的暴击需求也清零。: M6: only the extra attacks that scale with Anomaly Proficiency in the Victory State. Other attacks still need their own CRIT Rate.
messages.决胜状态额外精通倍率攻击: Extra attacks that scale with Anomaly Proficiency in the Victory State
messages.核心F；进入战场获得合道。: Core F: grants Unity upon entering battle.
messages.核心F熔锋状态。: Core F: applies in the Molten Edge state.
messages.M6；仅以太帷幕内的合唱。不能将其他攻击的暴击需求也清零。: M6: only Harmony inside an Ether Veil. Other attacks still need their own CRIT Rate.
messages.核心F；初始攻击最高的强攻队友成为正兵。换盘可能改变选中队友；比较候选时重新选人: Core F: the other Attack Agent with the highest initial ATK becomes the Vanguard. Changing Drive Discs may change who is selected; choose again when comparing candidates.
messages.M6；仅潜心创作中8秒的自身攻击。不能将其他攻击的暴击需求也清零。: M6: only her own attacks during the 8s Focused Creation! state. Other attacks still need their own CRIT Rate.
messages.潜心创作中8秒的自身攻击: Her own attacks during the 8s Focused Creation! state
messages.M1进入战场；同段喧响回复次数限制不能无依据套成暴击只持续180秒。: M1: granted upon entering battle. The Decibel recovery trigger limit in the same paragraph does not establish a 180s duration for the CRIT Rate bonus.
messages.R1～R5均20%；不是随叠影增加的数值。: 20% at every level from R1 to R5. This value does not increase with W-Engine refinement.
messages.核心F激活或刷新巡空枪势后的8秒。: Core F: lasts 8s after activating or refreshing Aerial Patrol Spear.
messages.原作者主属性方案为暴击4、穿透5、防御6，并明确丽娜队与减防队的穿透两件取舍不同: The original author's main stats are CRIT in slot 4, PEN Ratio in slot 5, and DEF in slot 6. They explicitly distinguish the PEN 2-piece choice in Rina teams from that in DEF-reduction teams.
messages.需输入丽娜有效穿透分享及其他减防来源；不能据此宣称穿透5永远优于电伤/防御。: Enter Rina's effective PEN Ratio sharing and other DEF-reduction sources. This alone does not establish that slot 5 PEN Ratio always outperforms Electric DMG or DEF.
messages.维持荆棘玫瑰所需初始防御及锐暴预算；暴伤仅按已验证初始转换计，不把战斗队友暴伤重: Maintain the initial DEF and Laceration DMG budget required for Thorned Rose. Count only the verified initial CRIT DMG conversion; do not convert teammates' combat CRIT DMG bonuses a second time.
messages.面板为基础装备估算：角色成长、突破、核心强化属性，音擎基础/高级属性，驱动盘主副: This estimates base equipment stats: Agent growth, promotion, Core Skill enhancement stats, W-Engine base/advanced stats, Drive Disc main/substats, and 2-piece effects.
messages.未计入音擎被动、驱动盘 4 件套效果、队伍增益与其他条件增益；不等同战斗面板或伤: Excludes W-Engine passives, Drive Disc 4-piece effects, team buffs, and other conditional bonuses. This is not a combat stat display or damage prediction.
messages.签序与等级已对照扫描；诗文依网页简体转录，未作逐字精校。: Slip order and grade were checked against the scan. The verse follows the webpage’s simplified-Chinese transcription and has not been critically checked character by character.
messages.东八区民用时间（UTC+8）；年柱按立春交接时刻划分，月柱按节令交接时刻划分。采: Uses UTC+8 civil time. Year and month pillars change at the relevant solar-term boundaries. Under sect=2, the day pillar changes at 00:00 rather than 23:00; the 23:00–23:59 hour stem uses the following day’s stem. Entered clock time is used without apparent-solar-time conversion or automatic historical daylight-saving correction.

messages.强攻或命破队：山大王四件套，搭配一组回能二件套。: Attack or Rupture teams: King of the Summit with one 2-piece Energy Regen set.
messages.强化特殊技触发套装；四件套暴伤收益不适用于锋御队友。: EX Special Attacks trigger the set; its 4-piece CRIT DMG benefit does not apply to Armorer teammates.
messages.锋御队：静听嘉音四件套，搭配一组回能二件套。: Armorer teams: Astral Voice with one 2-piece Energy Regen set.
messages.需要队伍快速支援触发；洛克茜不能自行稳定提供快速支援机会，请结合队友循环选择。: Requires the team to trigger Quick Assists. Roxy cannot consistently create these opportunities herself, so choose this set around teammate rotations.
messages.攻略主属性顺序：4号暴击率；5号穿透率优先，风伤与攻击力为备选；6号能量自动回复: Guide main stats: CRIT Rate on slot 4; prioritize PEN Ratio on slot 5, with Wind DMG or ATK as alternatives; Energy Regen on slot 6.
messages.2.88/秒是攻略培养参考；3.12/秒是核心F转换封顶条件，不能把两者混作同一: 2.88/s is a guide build reference; 3.12/s caps the Core F conversion. These are different targets.
messages.音擎参考：1阶绯月银棺优先；5阶人为刀俎为平民选项，1阶燃狱齿轮为其他备选。: W-Engine reference: prioritize S1 Crimson Moon Casket; S5 Steam Oven is an accessible option, with S1 Hellfire Gears as another alternative.
messages.套装与配装排序参考9月30日Prydwen攻略；机制公式依据正式客户端文本。未验: Set and build priorities reference Prydwen’s September 30 guide; mechanic formulas follow released game text. Maximum damage has not been verified for every Mindscape, W-Engine, team, and enemy combination.
messages.暴击率优先支持团队增益；暴伤、攻击力与穿透值为个人伤害参考。能量自动回复与冲击力: Prioritize CRIT Rate for the team buff; CRIT DMG, ATK, and flat PEN support personal damage. Energy Regen and Impact come from main stats, sets, or W-Engines and cannot appear as substats.
messages.攻略范围；1阶专武方案的面板参考为76%，配合专武24%暴击效果达到100%。请: Guide range. The S1 signature build references 76% panel CRIT Rate plus its 24% CRIT Rate effect to reach 100%; do not count the weapon effect twice.
messages.攻略建议2.88/秒以上；核心F的攻击与冲击转换上限仍需初始回能3.12/秒。: The guide recommends 2.88/s or higher. Capping Core F’s ATK and Impact conversion still requires 3.12/s initial Energy Regen.
messages.培养区间来自2026-09-30更新的Prydwen攻略；不等于所有影画、音擎与: Build ranges come from Prydwen’s September 30, 2026 update; they are not universal requirements for every Mindscape, W-Engine, or team.
messages.核心F的3.12/秒初始回能与100%生效时暴击率仍是独立机制上限，见下方公式。: Core F’s 3.12/s initial Energy Regen and 100% CRIT Rate at effect time remain separate mechanic caps; see the formulas below.
messages.已有9月30日攻略培养区间；推荐范围与机制封顶条件分开使用。: September 30 guide build ranges are available; use recommendation ranges separately from mechanic caps.
messages.暴击率优先支持团队增益；暴伤、攻击力与穿透值为个人伤害参考。能量自动回复与冲击力: Prioritize CRIT Rate for the team buff; CRIT DMG, ATK, and flat PEN support personal damage. Energy Regen and Impact cannot appear as substats; check other sources such as main stats, sets, W-Engines, and skills.

messages.下一个 S 级：代理人有 50% 是 UP，音擎有 75% 是 UP。没出 UP: Your next S-Rank is featured 50% of the time for agents and 75% for W-Engines. Missing the featured item is called losing the 50/50.
messages.上一个 S 级歪了，下一个 S 级一定是 UP。出了 UP 之后回到小保底。: If your last S-Rank was off-banner, the next one is always featured. After that you are back on the 50/50.
messages.角色池最多 90 抽出一个 S 级，音擎池最多 80 抽。最坏情况是先歪一次再出: An S-Rank comes within 90 pulls on agent channels and 80 on W-Engine channels. Worst case for the featured item is losing once first: 180 pulls for agents, 160 for W-Engines.
messages.保底状态和已垫抽数会带到下一期同类卡池，同时开放的两个卡池也共用；角色池、音擎池: Your guarantee and pity carry over to the next banner of the same type and are shared by banners running at the same time. Agent, W-Engine, standard and Bangboo channels are separate. Incomplete records show “Not sure yet” instead of a guess.
messages.「独家重映」频段有什么不同？: What is different about Exclusive Rescreening?
messages.独家重映（3.1 起的特殊复刻频段）单独计算抽数和保底。每期第一个 S 级必定是: Exclusive Rescreening (special rerun channels since 3.1) tracks its own pulls and guarantee. Your first S-Rank each phase is your selected featured agent (bonus guarantee), and it does not clear an existing guarantee. Reruns on normal banners follow the normal rules.

messages.每次拾取拟态单质都有概率获得一项侵蚀症状，部分症状可叠加；拾取越多，出现重度侵蚀: Each Mimic Substance pickup has a chance to cause Corruption. Some effects stack; more pickups increase the chance of Severe Corruption.
messages.背包和安全箱中的X/Y/Z各一枚会自动合成，单局可重复。合成本身不增加侵蚀；合成: One each of X, Y, and Z in the backpack and safe box automatically synthesizes, and this can repeat in one run. Synthesis adds no Corruption. Synthesizing or discarding substances does not remove existing symptoms; they disappear after successful extraction.
messages.背包和安全箱中的单质都参与合成，单局可重复。每次拾取有概率获得侵蚀；部分症状可叠: Substances in both the backpack and safe box count toward synthesis, which can repeat in one run. Each pickup may cause Corruption; some effects stack, and more pickups increase the chance of Severe Corruption. Synthesis adds no extra Corruption; discarding or synthesizing does not remove existing symptoms, which end after extraction. Targets With Substance have a Cacophony Shield by default, trigger Corruption Ambush more often, and may launch an additional Corruption follow-up attack afterward. The in-game map marks the substance type they carry; defeat them and open the Reverb Vessel to collect it. In UP Investigation Events, activate the beacon, defeat enemies, and open the Reverb Container to choose X, Y, or Z.
